reviewList.text:
I recently had the chance to experience Thương Ta Spa while visiting Da Nang, and I was truly very satisfied. It’s a local spa, but the service is highly professional. From the cozy atmosphere to the attentive service, everything made me feel comfortable right from the moment I walked in.

The staff here are extremely enthusiastic and friendly. They always checked in gently and adjusted the massage pressure to suit my preference. I was especially impressed with the bamboo massage — it felt very different from regular massages. The pressure was even and deep, and after the session, my body felt much lighter and noticeably more relaxed.

In addition, the herbal nourishing hair wash is definitely worth trying. Every step was done very carefully, using lightly scented herbal ingredients. The head, shoulder, and neck massage was incredibly relaxing — I almost fell asleep during the treatment. After finishing, my mind felt much more relaxed and refreshed.

What surprised me the most was the price, which is very reasonable compared to the quality of service. It was honestly an unexpectedly good price for such attentive and well-done care, making it feel truly worth the money.

Overall, I would say this is a local spa that operates with great professionalism, excellent service, and very dedicated staff. If I have the chance to visit Da Nang again, I will definitely return to Thương Ta Spa for another experience.

reviewList.text:
I’m extremely disappointed and angry with my experience here. 😤😡 The first photo is my skin now, and the second photo is my skin before I came to this clinic. I originally wanted a basic cleaning and hydration facial because I did not have inflamed acne or major skin concerns. However, the owner suggested the Aqua Glow treatment instead.

Two days before my birthday, I ended up dealing with red bumps, acne breakouts, irritation, texture, and persistent skin issues that I did not have before. As someone who regularly invests in skincare and professional treatments to prevent breakouts, it has been incredibly frustrating to watch my skin worsen after this facial.

What concerns me most is that the treatment included dermaplaning, which is already a form of exfoliation, followed by mandelic acid, another exfoliating treatmen this combination was too aggressive for my skin and appears to have damaged my skin barrier.

While I appreciate that the clinic attempted to compensate me with products, it does not change the fact that my skin has been negatively affected. The emotional impact has been significant as well!!! I have felt angry, frustrated, disappointed, and self-conscious about going out because of the condition of my skin.

I paid 800,000 VND expecting professional care and healthier skin, but instead I left with skin problems I am still trying to recover from. Based on my experience, I regret choosing this clinic and wish I had never undergone this treatment.

reviewList.text:
The problem with Asian massage parlors is that they don't specify what type of massage they provide—lymphatic drainage or classical. It's my own fault for not checking, and today it was a lymphatic drainage foot massage (not classical).

I don't like lymphatic drainage, and I don't like this kind of massage. It's like "rubbing" your legs rather than carefully working the muscles. After such a massage, in my case, it doesn't feel like a massage at all.

It's a visually pleasing place, and people come there for a massage and a hair wash - as I notice.
I observed a girl giving a head and face massage, and it seemed very attentive on her part.

So, I won't go there for a body or leg massage, but I will go for a hair wash. I'll give it a second chance.

Before I even come there, the owner was very responsive on messenger.

Location: location is fine, probably 5 mins away from the tail of the dragon bridge by motorbike. The sign board is a little bit small tho, but it is not really hard to find.

Prices: I feel like the prices are actually cheap compared to other places where the prices are double or even triple the amount. I only paid 250k vnd for the back massage and hair wash. 👍👍👍

The experience: The therapist was very accomodating and naking sure that the pressure is just right. I came in with back pain and she was able to focus in the parts that were really tensed. The last part of the massage was actually amazing when she streched my back and the cracking sounds were very satisfying. 🤣 After the massage was the shampoo, it was so relaxing that I actually fell asleep 😂. I have a really long hair but she was very patient especially when blow drying my hair. After, there was a small treat (yogurt) which I also enjoyed.

The only downside that I have noticed was that the place is quite small since the business is relatively new so it may be hard if you want to go as a couple or as a group. So, I hope more people can discover this place so she can get a bigger place next time!

I would definitely come again! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

The owner was wonderful and clearly put a lot of care into every part of the treatment. She was attentive, gentle, and made sure I felt comfortable throughout the entire session.

The beginning was lovely — tea, a consultation form, choosing the oil, a beautiful changing area with thoughtful details, clean and pleasantly scented showers, and even a rose-petal foot ritual. The atmosphere was charming and promising.
However, I was surprised to be asked to pay immediately upon arrival, which felt unusual and slightly concerning. I chose an oil massage described beautifully in the menu and was expecting a high-quality, professional treatment.
Instead, the massage consisted mostly of simple up-and-down strokes without real technique. When I politely asked for more structured massage movements, the therapist left to bring a receptionist into the room while I was almost undressed, interrupting both my privacy and my session. I was then asked how exactly I wanted the massage to be done, which felt surprising for a salon with such a reputation. I was offered a different therapist and a different treatment, but I had specifically chosen this service and was limited in time, as I am a mother of a young child. I declined and asked to simply complete the session.
The pressure later became too strong, and when I asked to reduce it, another staff member entered again and offered to stop the massage and refund me. While I appreciate the refund, the overall handling of the situation felt unprofessional and lacking sensitivity. It would have been more appropriate to allow me to finish the treatment and then discuss my concerns afterward.
Thank you for the refund. However, for a young mother, time and relaxation are far more valuable — and unfortunately, those cannot be returned.
reviewList.author: L B

reviewList.text:
I visited this place during my trip to Da Nang, and it exceeded my expectations.
The facility was very clean and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing from the moment I walked in.

I really liked that I could choose the massage oil beforehand, and the therapist consistently checked the pressure to make sure it was just right—not too strong or too weak.
The massage itself was excellent and helped relieve all the fatigue from my trip.

The staff were friendly, and there was some Korean support available, which made everything very convenient.

I would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Da Nang, and I would gladly come back again. 👍
reviewList.author: 박민우

reviewList.text: I went without an appointment, but they were able to fit me in an hour later, and since it was during happy hour, I got a discount. They gave me a thorough full-body massage, focusing especially on my shoulders and lower back. They checked in with me periodically to make sure the pressure wasn’t too strong. I felt completely relaxed. A light snack and drink were included at the beginning and end of the session. I’d love to come back the next time I’m in Da Nang. Thank you very much.
reviewList.author: Ma Ya

places.name: ARI SPA
places.address: Lô 08 Phạm Văn Đồng, An Hải

reviewList.text: Had an absolutely rejuvenating experience at Ari Spa in Da Nang! The ambiance is serene with a perfect blend of traditional Vietnamese elements and modern luxury. I went for the signature aromatherapy massage, and the therapist was incredibly skilled—left me feeling relaxed and energized. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Kwok Ho YAU (Henry)

reviewList.text:
We entered but got out because we were not happy with the reception service.
- they have a survey about our needs about focused partS ( multiple options) before the session, but when we request they say they can only focus ONE part due to the content of the session. ( then they should have written in the question list)

- they decide the tip price for 2 USD/ session. TIPS IS VOLUNTEER BASED ON THE SERVICE IF IT IS GOOD OR NOT- cannot be decided from spa side.
Price is higher than other spas surroundings, if they do not improve their service we do not think they can survive.
reviewList.author: Huyen Lam

reviewList.text:
5 star massage at DaNang!

Clean and kind, nice place for the whole family 4-year-old child included.

Also they take care of the baggages during the waiting time
reviewList.author: Dongwon Shin

reviewList.text: The service is very good: they provide a pick-up car from your accommodation! The staff is very kind and careful. I enjoyed the massage, it was very relaxing. Thank you for the late massage! I will use again :)
reviewList.author: Rubie HJ

reviewList.text: I’ve had many massages before, but I was truly moved by Nab’s touch. Her hands are both delicate and powerful, melting away every bit of tension in my body. For 90 minutes, I felt like I was in heaven. It was such an incredible experience that I’ll now be coming back every day—and next time, I’ll be booking the full 120-minute massage with her.
reviewList.author: Halim Ro

reviewList.text: This is definitely one of the better massage place in Da Nang.  The service can be truly felt from entering the door all the way until leaving.  The girls at front desk are always smiling and ready to serve and the more important thing is to come with a reservation!  I have been having massage here multiple times already and I’m very satisfied with their massage service.   The therapists are skillful and often communicates with you in making sure you are relaxed and the pressure is right!  The place is nicely presented for a nice visual experience and the rooms are tidy, organized and clean.  I tried the 90-min Deep Tissue, 90-min leg massage and even the hair shampoo and all were upto the standards and beyond.  But I must say the shampoo session, if too many people at the same time, do have challenges to manage the water temperature!  They also have the hair wash ring which is a unique experience for all foreigner visiting and something they should try here in Vietnam.  Their fee includes the service charge already but you can definitely tip the therapist further if you feel she did a great job taking care of you!!  At start, slip on their slippers and treated with an iced cold drink with Da Nang specialty coconut crackers, this is always great coming in from a hot afternoon!  You can also buy the crackers for 25K if you want to take some home.  You also choose your massage oil with the coconut & lemongrass @20K or an unscented oil with no additional charge.  You will be presented with the bill and do pay with cash as cards will have additional card fees on top.  And when the massage is completed, you will have another cold drink with watermelon to snack on before leaving.  Overall, a well structured massage experience that’s enjoying, relaxing, and well serviced.
reviewList.author: Steven Man

reviewList.text: This is my new favorite massage location right now. If you like to suffer like I do, choose deep tissue massage. As someone is active in sport and gym, it feels sooo good! Staff is very caring and professional. They give you snack and drink before and after massage. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Tien Nguyen

reviewList.text:
It was really nice experience. Front desk staffs are very friendly and the staffs who performed hair and facial massage for us are really skill full. Would highly recommend. Thanks for the service.

Since I can’t write another review again, I will add on here. This is our third time here and no word needed. It is just amazing and amazing. We love it.
reviewList.author: May Thingyan

reviewList.text: The massage was absolutely wonderful, we tried the hot stone massage and deep tissue therapy. They were both great the therapists were really polite and gentle. They also have 30% discount for the next spa. Definitely worth coming again
reviewList.author: cheuk hang ng

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful experience here. The staff are very hospitable, and the massage was excellent. We chose the soft-pressure massage, which was incredibly relaxing. The prices are also more affordable compared to many other spa and massage services in Da Nang. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Sygee Botantan

reviewList.text:
The best massage I’ve had in my entire life!! A knot HATES to see them coming. I came out feeling super light and relaxed. The four hand massage is a game changer and must!!

The facility is super clean and they’re so professional!
reviewList.author: Elsie Paulino

reviewList.text: My wife and I had a truly wonderful experience enjoying a couples massage here on our anniversary night. The four-hands massage was a novel and excellent experience for us, complemented by the very warm welcome from the staff and the exceptionally relaxing atmosphere. This has been one of the best massages I have ever received.
reviewList.author: Joren Refuerzo

reviewList.text: Nice ambience. friendly & attentive staff.  skilful and meticulous therapists with strong, slow strokes . calm massage. Nice dessert! Tho a bit more pricey than those along common streets! But Best so far! Especially the four hands! Don’t miss!
reviewList.author: Rick Yang

reviewList.text: Today I felt so healed and relaxed after the 4-hour healing package at Herbal Spa. The experience was truly top-tier — all the ladies provided wonderful service, and their massage techniques were incredibly skilled. My back and shoulder pain are completely gone, and I feel deeply relaxed. I’m so glad I got to have this experience on the last day of my Da Nang trip.
reviewList.author: Rika Pajrin

reviewList.text:
I’ve just finished my body massage and foot massage at Herbal Spa, and honestly, my whole body feels completely renewed.

From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere truly reflected what a high-quality spa Da Nang should feel like — calm lighting, soft music, and a gentle herbal aroma that instantly helped me relax after a long day. The staff welcomed me warmly and asked about my pressure preference and any areas of tension before starting, which made me feel well taken care of.

The massage Da Nang body treatment was the highlight. The therapist used a perfect balance of strength and technique, focusing on my shoulders, back, and legs. Every movement felt intentional and professional, helping to release deep muscle tension while still being incredibly relaxing. Halfway through, I found myself drifting into a peaceful, almost meditative state.

After the body massage, the foot massage was exactly what I needed. My feet felt light and refreshed, especially after walking around the city all day. The pressure points were well-targeted, improving circulation and leaving my legs feeling relaxed and energized at the same time.

Once the session ended, I was offered a warm herbal tea and given time to fully unwind before leaving. That small touch really completed the experience and showed the level of care this spa provides.

If you’re looking for an authentic spa Da Nang experience with professional massage Da Nang techniques and a deeply relaxing foot massage, Herbal Spa is absolutely worth visiting. I walked out feeling lighter, calmer, and fully recharged — exactly what a great spa experience should deliver.
reviewList.author: Emma Le

reviewList.text:
Went to this spot as a solo female around 1pm on a Tuesday with no reservation. Just had to wait 15m! I got the 2 hour massage because I’ve been averaging 20k steps around Vietnam and really needed it, especially cuz I’m leaving tomorrow morning and going to be on a flight. Very pleasant and relaxing experience! Organized, not chaotic, peaceful, exactly what I needed. I would definitely come here again!

They were attentive to the form I filled out, place was very clean and safe! I especially liked that my massage was in a private room with private bathroom.
reviewList.author: Leah Acosta

reviewList.text: My husband and I just enjoyed an incredibly relaxing yet energizing 2 hour massage!  Cong Spa and Nail is a quiet, cozy and beautiful spa just a 2 minute walk from the Han Market and River.  We had the Dry Massage which incorporates stretching and deep massage.  The therapists were amazing!  Huong was phenomenal! This was our first massage here and we will definitely be back!
reviewList.author: K Carter

reviewList.text: The massage is excellent! My massage lady is very professional and nice. Her skills and attitude are amazing. Shop is clean and smell extremely nice. Great spot to pass by for a relaxing evening!
reviewList.author: Guest

reviewList.text:
(4 star update update after fourth visit)
I got aroma massages four times on my trip, plus one foot heel scrub. Three of the massages were quite good and I was satisfied. Unfortunately, the last one was underwhelming. I was given the same amount of pressure the previous three times, but the last therapist had a light touch and I had to ask her to press harder. It was still too soft. The waistband on the spa pants were often worn out and way too big.

The relaxation room is nice and calming.

(5 star original review)
The service is great when considering the cost. I appreciate the private rooms and nice ambience. The windows have very little sound proofing so traffic outside can be heard in the room. The therapist also sometimes bumped into the bed, but considering the cost, these small things are fine. Everyone is polite and the massage itself was great!
reviewList.author: Soyoung Jang

reviewList.text: Passed by this afternoon and was invited in by the staff wearing traditional Ao Dai. The reviews were spot on—the environment is great and the two-hour massage was excellent. Highly recommended if you are visiting Da Nang.
reviewList.author: WJ

reviewList.text:
I literally went to space during this massage 😭✨
Everything was absolutely amazing from start to finish. The therapist was incredibly polite, friendly, and professional, and the massage itself was one of the best I’ve ever had.

The salon is super clean, smells amazing, and has everything you could possibly need — shower, restroom, lockers, and all the little essentials to freshen up and feel comfortable before and after the treatment.

Such a relaxing and luxurious experience. Highly recommend this place if you want to fully unwind and treat yourself 💆‍♀️🌿

And their mango coffee is absolutely out of this world 🥭☕️
reviewList.author: Lana Trotner

reviewList.text:
Therapist was great. Asked for a hard massage. She constantly checked in to see if I am okay with the session.
A survey form at the start of the session helped to let me identify the problem areas. The therapist then worked on the targeted areas. This effectively removed the language barrier.
reviewList.author: TY Koh

reviewList.text: Did the signature massage and 8 year daughter did the kids massage. Great experience and the selected level of pressure was what I expected. Clean and friendly establishment would definitely visit again
reviewList.author: Derek S

reviewList.text:
This is by far one of the best massages I've gotten. Hoi Bay was an exceptional masseuse. I've had plenty of massages in my life and this has been the best one yet! She was thorough and kept the intensity of pressure throughout the 60mins. After the massage, they offer you tea or juice.

The staff was very attentive and mindful. They provided great service. However? They only accept cash. This was worth the visit. I wanted to try it out because this is where Jungkook and Jimin got their massages in season 2 of Are You Sure? And this place did not disappoint. I'm coming back for round 2 before leaving vietnam!
reviewList.author: Aileen Dy

reviewList.text: Excellent massage, great experience from start to finish. Lovely, clean and very chilled atmosphere. Private bathroom/changing room. They’re currently doing 20% discount. Would come again!
reviewList.author: Chasing Sunsets

reviewList.text: Great massage shop with a variety and massage style options (ie. Aromatherapy, Thai, Swedish, etc). They were offering 50% off on most of their services, which was incredible value. I opted for a 2hr massage and it worked out to be less than 500,000 vnd ($18USD). Staff was friendly and accommodating even though I didn't have a reservation booked. Front desk girl that assisted me was able to speak English and was very friendly and helpful. The room was very clean and comfortable, despite it being almost 40 degrees outside. The massage therapist was very good and 10mins into the session, another staff member came in to make sure I was happy with everything so far. Overall great experience and customer service. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: D Y

reviewList.text: I’ve ordered the mind rebalance package. It is a full body care including aroma massage, body scrub, facial massage + mask and hair shampoo. The therapist Ms Nhan has good technique, and always ask if the service is okay. The plan was finished with fruit (watermelon and mango) and herbal tea (seem to have cinnamon and ginger). It is a really comfortable experience.
reviewList.author: Yen Law

reviewList.text: We had an amazing experience at Sum Spa Da Nang. Super relaxing atmosphere, professional staff, and one of the best massages I've had during my trip. Had a 60 min aroma therapy massage here and it was excellent. Clean place, calming vibe, and the therapists were very skilled. Perfect after a long day of travel. Totally worth it!
reviewList.author: Devendra Patil

reviewList.text: The staff was nice. Did the relaxing shampoo &Hair wash treatment.  Nothing in particular amazed me, except the shampoo I chose—a one-off experience. Towards the end of treatment, they provide fruits and ginger tea. The fruits were delicious, and the ginger tea was amazing.  Very strong ginger taste, loved it!
reviewList.author: Lucy W

reviewList.text: I had thai spa. Their thai spa is good. If you like strong thai spa or chinese spa, choose their thai spa instead of Vietnamese or foot massage. The girl massage me is strong, the environment is more peaceful than heart spa. & they use heated sand bag on neck & eye & foot. More than heart spa . 1 hr thai 🇹🇭 massage 345000.
reviewList.author: T T

reviewList.text: I had a two-hour massage yesterday that was already amazing—I didn’t think it could get any better. But trying a four-hand massage for the first time completely transformed the experience. It felt endless, like waves of relaxation flowing without pause. Pam Spa was welcoming and attentive, from the moment I walked in to the care after the session. The therapists’ movements, while not perfectly that felt wonderful. The pressure stayed consistent throughout, which made it even more enjoyable. Honestly, it’s going to be tough going back to the usual foot massages we get in the US after this.
reviewList.author: BK

reviewList.text:
Came here based on the excellent reviews, and it definitely lived up to the hype. The therapist was highly skilled, the place was clean and comfortable, and the staff were friendly and welcoming. They even offered us a discount, which was a nice touch.

I would highly recommend their full combo package, which includes facial treatment, hair care, and a massage. It was great value for money and provided a complete head-to-toe rejuvenating experience in a single session. Definitely worth trying if you’re looking to pamper yourself while in Da Nang. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
reviewList.author: Kingkong18

reviewList.text:
My mom and I visited PAM Spa during our trip to Da Nang, and it was truly one of the highlights of our vacation.

The massage was absolutely amazing. After several days of traveling and walking around the city, we both had sore muscles and felt quite tired. The therapists were very professional and skilled, providing the perfect pressure and paying close attention to our comfort throughout the session. We left feeling completely refreshed, relaxed, and energized.

The spa itself was clean, peaceful, and beautifully maintained. The staff were welcoming, friendly, and attentive from the moment we arrived. Their hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable. My mom especially loved the massage and said it was one of the best she has ever had.

What made this visit even more special was being able to enjoy such a relaxing experience together with my mother. It became one of our favorite memories from Da Nang.
I highly recommend PAM Spa to anyone looking for a high-quality massage and exceptional service. We will definitely return the next time we visit Da Nang. Thank you to the wonderful team at PAM Spa for such a fantastic experience!
reviewList.author: 김지은

reviewList.text:
Very professional massage spa. All of the staff were very friendly, I was greeted with tea and crackers and then after my massage more tea and some mango!

I paid just 100,000 VND for a foot massage and it was one of the best I have had. Loan was the lady who massaged me, she is very good. I will definitely be back - thank you so much!
reviewList.author: Liam Waterworth

reviewList.text:
They are amazing service
I and my husband had back head neck and shoulders massage 1 hr.
And I had Painting and decorating fingernails and toenails 2 staffs work on it about 1.10hr. Then My husband and I came back again for foot massage 1hr. After finish they serve mango and tea. Really so happy I always recommend my friends to go there.
reviewList.author: Nok Sri

places.name: Levenin Spa & Massage Danang - 다낭 마사지

reviewList.text: I and my husband had a fantastic full body massage, my husband chose the aroma oil and loved it! I top it all up with shampoo and facial with mask and I felted so relaxed, the head massage felt incredible and the lady was amazing! The welcome since we entered the place was superb and the smell since you enter is amazing and such a sense of relaxation. The place exceeded my expectation. All the ladies are so kind and friendly. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: StarDan

reviewList.text:
I chose the 45-minute Body Scrub treatment. The only scrub available was the coffee one, and I absolutely loved both the scent and the effect. I expected it to be just a body wrap, but it also included a wonderfully long and relaxing body massage with lotion that had a very soft and pleasant fragrance.

My husband had an oil massage, which he also really enjoyed. It even helped relieve a headache that had been bothering him for quite some time.

Thank you for your care, warm welcome, and wonderful experience 🤍🌸
reviewList.author: Renya

reviewList.text:
Really happy with my experience at Levinin Spa. The service was very attentive and professional — staff were friendly and responsive that made me feel relaxed from start to finish. The treatment itself was effective and well-done, you can tell they have good technique and experience.
Booking was also very convenient and smooth, easy to arrange without any hassle, which I really appreciate.
Overall, it’s definitely an option — great value for the quality you get. Just note that there is an 8% surcharge if not pay by cash, so better prepare cash if you want to save a bit.
Will come back again 👍
reviewList.author: Celeste Li

reviewList.text:
So glad a friend recommended this place to us! There are so many massage and spa places to choose from in Da Nang, it’s easy to get overwhelmed. But this place had clean beds, sweet staff, and expert hands.

Before you start, you fill out a form to indicate which areas to focus on or avoid, and they were very careful to follow the guidance. I did the 90 min aroma massage and my lady was able to get the knots out of my shoulders which I’m so grateful for. I also got the 60 min shampoo/head/neck massage, though I might skip that next time as it was more like a head scratching versus massaging motion.

Overall the price is reasonable for what you’re getting so if you want to treat yourself, definitely give this place a try!

They have a great website that lists all their services and prices. Booking an appointment was easy via what’s app and they were able to accommodate 3 of us on the same day. They do charge an 8% credit card fee, so bring cash if you can.
reviewList.author: hungerdontlai

reviewList.text: Had a great massage experience! The staff were very friendly, and the therapist kept checking if the intensity and heat level were comfortable throughout the session. We were also served tea and snacks after the massage, which was a lovely touch. Excellent service and a relaxing atmosphere. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: ssu syun

attribution.name: Levenin Spa & Massage Danang - 다낭 마사지

places.name: Jang Mi Spa Massage Da Nang - Riverside

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5

Had the 60-minute foot massage at JANG MI SPA and it was amazing.
The spa is clean, quiet, and has a really nice aroma.
The staff were professional and the pressure was just right — relaxing but still strong enough to release tension.
They massaged from feet up to the calves with a warm herbal compress, and it felt incredible.
I almost fell asleep!

After the session, my legs felt light and refreshed.
Great value for the price.
If you’re traveling in Da Nang or Hoi An, JANG MI SPA is definitely worth a visit.
Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: 유툽각

reviewList.text: I had a great face massage and basic hair wash. At first I thought this place was a bit pricey compare to other places in town, yet I was in a hurry thus decided to go in. However, the service quality match its price. I even thought about tipping the staff who took care of me since she was so sincere and attentive (turns out the tip was included jn the price). The place is clean, the lighting and music volume are all well set. Will definitely go back.
reviewList.author: Chau Nguyen

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at Jang Mi Spa. The staff were incredibly kind and professional, and you can really tell they are skilled at what they do. The whole atmosphere was calm and relaxing, which made it easy to unwind. I went in with back pain, and they took great care of me—the massage really helped relieve the tension. Highly recommend if you're looking for a relaxing and effective spa experience.
reviewList.author: Sonali Jain

reviewList.text: I did the deep tissue massage 60 minutes, and it was an excellent experience! Pleasantly surprised with the price and the staff were very welcoming & friendly. One of the best massages I’ve had! And you really can’t beat the price. 5/5 would recommend
reviewList.author: Jesse Chang

reviewList.text: Friendly staff that speaks fluent English, super welcoming and we enjoyed some good snacks before and after treatment. Defo one of the best treatments i had in a long while, and the hair feels very silky post shampoo!
reviewList.author: Esther H

attribution.name: Jang Mi Spa Massage Da Nang - Riverside
Jang Mi Spa Massage Da Nang - Riverside

places.name: Pam Spa Sora & Massage Da Nang

reviewList.text:
I recently had the chance to experience a traditional Vietnamese hair wash at IKIGAI SPA CENTER, and it was absolutely amazing.
From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt calm and relaxing. The staff were very welcoming and professional, making me feel comfortable right away. The hair washing service was much more than just a simple wash — it felt like a full relaxation treatment.
They started with a gentle scalp massage that helped relieve all my stress. The techniques were slow, rhythmic, and incredibly soothing. Then came the shampooing, which was done very carefully and thoroughly, followed by a neck and shoulder massage that made the whole experience even better.
What I loved most was how attentive they were to every detail. The warm water, the soft movements, and the peaceful environment made it feel like a mini spa retreat.
After the wash, my hair felt super clean, soft, and refreshed. I also felt mentally relaxed and recharged.
If you are visiting Vietnam, I highly recommend trying a Vietnamese hair wash, especially at IKIGAI SPA CENTER. It’s not just about clean hair — it’s a unique and relaxing experience you shouldn’t miss 🥰🥰🥰
reviewList.author: กันตรัตน์ โพธิ์เย็น

reviewList.text:
Pam Spa Sora & Massage in Da Nang is so good. It was literally few steps from our AirBnB.

As soon as you get inside they give coconut water and some snacks. Then after the service they give you Mango slices and another drink.

Ngoc Nho (number 84) she was so good, It was one of the best massage that I have had for a long time. She listened to what intensity of the massage that I want and she was great. I highly recommend her, she was a small women but she was so good. I got the Thai Massage with oil and they had hot stones. As a women I have never had a another woman sat on me and just used her strength to massage me. OMG it felt better with all the walking we've been doing.

The place was clean, smells good and the staff were all very friendly.

My Daughter had fake nails extension and Art and she loved it. To all my fellow Canadian who is coming to Da Nang please visit this place. It's affordable and definitely cheaper that what we pay back in Canada. Worth every penny. You can Grab it from your hotel.  Would definitely be back here if we visit Da Nang again, and will recommend to  friends and family.
reviewList.author: Lian Eligh

reviewList.text: Amazing experience! My 7-year-old daughter and I both had a very relaxing massage. The staff were friendly, professional, and made us feel comfortable throughout. We left feeling refreshed and would definitely come back. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Lahiru Ishan

reviewList.text:
Had a really nice time at Pam Spa Sora
The massage was great — super relaxing and just what I needed. The place is clean and comfortable, with a nice atmosphere.
The staff were really friendly and made me feel welcome right away
Definitely a spot worth checking out if you’re in the area
reviewList.author: Tường Vy

reviewList.text: The service is great here. I was met, and walked to the spa room. They served me tea, biscuits before the session. The therapist was so kind, she asked me if I feel good all along. Massage was really nice. Then I was offered mango with some tea afterwards, which I didn’t expect. It was so sweet of them. Thank you were much.
reviewList.author: Єва Сучалкіна

attribution.name: Pam Spa Sora & Massage Da Nang

places.name: Han River Spa (Song Han Spa) 송한스파 | ハンリバースパ | 韩江水疗中心 | منتجع صحي
places.address: Lầu 5 Khách sạn Sông Hàn, 14 Lý Tự Trọng, Hải Châu

reviewList.text:
I just had the most amazing, unforgettable experience at Hahn River Spa! I booked a massage, and it was unlike anything I've ever had before. Be prepared: this is not your standard, gentle rubdown. The therapists truly get in there—at one point, I had knees in my glutes for deep pressure and rhythmic slapping on my back, and I was covered in oil from head to toe. It sounds wild, but it was absolutely incredible. It worked out every knot and left me feeling fantastic. Highly recommend if you're open to a seriously effective, traditional treatment!

UPDATE: Second trip was even better than the first!
reviewList.author: Amy Baker

reviewList.text:
Came here with Google map review. Had Aroma massage 90min without any booking but they are very well prepared for any drop-by customers.
Massage started with face up, with tummy massages which is very rare in Vietnam. Was a nice surprise to have a truly “full body” massage.

The spa is located inside local hotel, & you pay the spa fees downstairs at the lobby including the tips, so no need to worry about how much tips to give. Credit card payment is available, which is easier for international travelers.
reviewList.author: A MT

reviewList.text:
I’m not quite sure why the reviews are that good here, it was definitely a negative experience!

First, I walked into the hotel to look for the spa and the hotel receptionist at the lobby gave me a menu. I was surprised as the menu prices were definitely higher than listed on the website. A little shady for me from the beginning. The only told me to go upstairs to lvl 5 when I showed her the website menu prices, and she realized I had a reservation.

Second, the interior of the spa place looks quite old and a little run down. Still we had a booking and there were good reviews so we went ahead.

The bed was a little stiff and I had a backache after 1 hour. Foot massage I received (90mins) was not the best, lower than average, didn’t really feel rejuvenated after. My husband’s therapist strength was weak, but when he asked for more strength, the therapist’s nails were digging painfully into his skin so he had to request again for less strength. Not acceptable really.

Would not return. They provide return voucher in exchange for google review btw.
reviewList.author: Rennie Lee

reviewList.text: I never leave reviews, but I had to for this one. The massage was incredibly relaxing and very professional. They found all the tight spots and used the perfect amount of pressure. I’ll definitely be coming back. 10/10.
reviewList.author: jle

reviewList.text: Definitely should visit here if you want a high quality and professional massage.  Everyone is super friendly, kind and very welcoming. Massage therapists are very experienced and also the receptionists and host, she is terrific.  Very great service!!  Private rooms available and much better than massage shops on the street.

reviewList.text:
Overall, it was a nice and relaxing massage experience. I chose the premium essential oil option with strong pressure because I was looking for a deeper, more therapeutic massage. While the massage itself was enjoyable and the oils smelled great, I felt the pressure could have been stronger and more focused in certain areas.

Before the session, I filled out a form with focus areas, and although they did work well on my shoulders and neck, I didn’t feel much attention was given to my calves, which I had specifically selected as well.

They also used hot stones during the massage, which I hadn’t requested. Some people may enjoy that, but for me it felt like it took time away from the deeper massage work I was hoping for.

One downside was the construction noise next door, which could be a bit distracting during the session. I also didn't get a back stretch, which is quite usual other places.

That said, the atmosphere was still relaxing overall, and the experience was pleasant. Just not quite the stronger, more targeted massage I expected.

reviewList.text:
The head spa here is truly an experience that everyone should try at least once. At first, I only planned to get a simple hair wash to relax, but what I received went far beyond my expectations. It wasn’t just a regular shampoo session—it was a full treatment, done with care, precision, and genuine intention to help customers unwind.

The moment I lay back in the chair, I could already feel the comfort: the seat was soft, my neck felt supported, the lighting was gentle, and the quiet atmosphere immediately put me at ease. The therapist started with a gentle scalp massage, then moved slowly down to the neck, shoulders, and nape. Every movement was technical, precise, and perfectly balanced—not too strong to cause discomfort, but not too light to feel ineffective. I nearly fell asleep because it was so relaxing.

The washing process was thorough and done with great attention to detail. Each section of hair was handled carefully, almost like a therapy session rather than just washing. The scent of the shampoo was pleasant, and the water temperature was always adjusted to the perfect warmth. What I appreciated most was how the staff constantly checked in to make sure I was comfortable and asked if I wanted anything adjusted. It made me feel genuinely cared for throughout the entire session.

After the massage and wash, the blow-dry and styling were done very gently. My hair looked smooth, neat, and healthy—without being dried out or frizzy. I walked out feeling lighter, more relaxed, and almost as if my whole mind had been refreshed after a long and tiring day.

Honestly, the head spa here is more than just a hair service—it’s a treatment for your hair, body, and spirit. Something I would gladly return for again and again.

reviewList.text: Very professional and hardworking team at Quoc Phong Hair Salon. Everyone was so friendly and made sure to guide me on what would suit my hair best. The results truly speak for themselves — I’m really happy with how my hair turned out. Highly recommend!!

reviewList.text:
I visited Maha Spa and overall, it was an okay experience—but not one I’d recommend if you’re truly looking for a relaxing, high-quality massage.
The facilities were one of the biggest downsides. There wasn’t proper indoor shoe storage, and the men’s and women’s changing areas were more like small stalls with partially working lockers. From what my partner experienced, the women’s lockers didn’t even have keys, which made it impossible to securely store belongings. The staff didn’t seem too concerned when this was brought up, which was disappointing.
We booked a 90-minute session that included a herbal hot compress, hot stone treatment, and foot massage. The foot bath portion was decent—they cleaned and lightly massaged our feet well. My massage itself was good, with strong and consistent pressure from the therapist. However, my partner had a much less pleasant experience and felt uncomfortable, especially when the therapist described her as being “difficult,” which was frustrating since we were just trying to relax.
The massage setup also lacked privacy. The beds were all in one large room, separated only by sheer curtains. You could hear therapists whispering and talking to each other or other clients, which really took away from the overall relaxation.
They did serve jasmine tea at the beginning and end, along with a mango pudding dessert. Unfortunately, the pudding tasted sour, so we didn’t eat it.
On a positive note, there was a very cute and friendly cat near the entrance, which was a nice touch.
Overall, while parts of the massage were decent, the lack of proper facilities, privacy, and attentiveness from staff made it hard to fully enjoy the experience. I wouldn’t recommend this place if you’re looking for a truly relaxing spa visit.

reviewList.text:
Genuinely so happily surprised by how amazing this massage was. They found all my sore spots and really worked on them to help relieve my back, neck, and shoulder pain. It was so comfortable, and my masseuse was incredibly lovely and kind — always checking in to make sure I was okay.

I’m not going to lie, I love a massage that’s actually strong and feels like it’s properly relieving all my tension, and this absolutely delivered. Worth every dollar. I got the ginger cream back, neck, and shoulder treatment, and I can only imagine how amazing all their other services are too!!

reviewList.text:
We booked the 90-minute four-hands massage hoping for a relaxing and rejuvenating experience. We get massages regularly both in the US and while traveling, and have experienced four-hands treatments in many countries, so we have a solid basis for comparison.

While the massage may be acceptable by local standards, it did not feel like a true four-hands experience. The therapists were not synchronized at all. At one point, my left hand and fingers were being pulled while nothing was happening on the right side, which completely disrupted the flow a four-hands massage is meant to provide.

Communication was also very challenging. Without using a translation app, it was nearly impossible to communicate with the therapists. When I asked them to skip the bottoms of my feet, they didn’t understand. When I requested lighter pressure, they simply stopped working on that area altogether. During the session, my husband’s therapists chatted and giggled for much of the time, and my younger therapist occasionally joined in, while the older therapist remained mostly quiet. This was distracting and not relaxing—people go to spas to unwind, not to listen to staff conversations.

We had four therapists in total. The older therapist appeared to be guiding the other three, but one of the younger therapists pulled my left arm so forcefully that it caused pain, and I had to ask them to stop. The therapists also took bathroom breaks during the session. What made this uncomfortable was that they were using the bathroom inside the room, as we repeatedly heard toilet flushing, which felt unprofessional. One therapist slipped a couple of times while applying oil to my shoulder, indicating excessive oil use and poorly controlled movements. My left arm was still sore 48 hours later.

We didn't need pickup services and received the complimentary shampoo service while my husband had the foot scrub. I was led into a dimly lit room where three men were already having their hair washed, which was extremely uncomfortable. I later met them at check out and the guys also felt awkward when a stranger entered their space. I felt uneasy throughout the experience, unsure of what to expect. The stylist ended my session early, explaining that there were men in the room and took me back to the first floor to finish blow-drying my hair. For future guests, it would be helpful to clearly inform customers in advance that the shampoo area is a shared space so they can decide whether they are comfortable with that arrangement. My husband’s foot scrub, however, was fine. They also offer 15% discount off and I got a simply wax. Again, I used the translation app and it was ok.

Overall, the professionalism and coordination fell short of expectations. It wasn’t a terrible massage, but it was underwhelming and did not deliver the quality we anticipated. This service may be acceptable for guests new to four-hands massages, but for more experienced spa-goers, it may not meet expectations.

The owner contacted us on WhatsApp after booking and was extremely responsive and easy to coordinate with. Since we were already near the spa on our first visit, they even offered a free foot scrub or hair shampoo instead of transportation, which was a nice touch.

The staff were welcoming, and we had a couple’s room. The spa itself appeared very clean and modern, which made the experience even more comfortable. They also provide shorts for customers to wear during the massage, which both men and women use. The four-hands massage was very well done—the therapists were perfectly in sync and mirrored each other, creating a balanced and relaxing experience. Communication was simple but effective, and the full 90 minutes were honored. Afterward, they provided snacks and water.

I highly recommend Bee Honey Spa if you’re looking for a quality massage in Da Nang. I’ll definitely return on my next visit.

reviewList.text:
Rating: ⭐ (0/5)

THEY RUINED MY HAIR AND GASLIT ME—STAY AWAY!!!

I am beyond devastated. I walked into this salon with natural, healthy hair down to my belly button. I showed clear photos of a low-maintenance, dark-blonde-to-cream balayage. They ignored my instructions and my photos ENTIRELY, bleaching 80% of my head and structurally ruining the integrity of my hair from day one. However, my hair looked good, not what I asked for but I liked it (even if it was now in awful condition).

Months later I went back for a basic maintenance appointment—just a root touch-up and the same toner—they somehow managed to completely mess it up. They turned my entire head STRAWBERRY BLONDE with ORANGE roots. When I called them out on this disaster, they tried to gaslight me, claiming it was '90% similar' and 'exactly what I had before.' It wasn’t. My family, my friends, and the professionals I had to hire to fix this all agree: it was a botched, incompetent mess. A professional should be able to replicate a result, but these people just guess. Guessed wrong then tried to lie then blame me. They FINALLY admitted it wasn't the same colour and agreed to correct it. The correction didn't work. I had to go to another hair dressers and pay even more for them to correct it further.

THE PHYSICAL DAMAGE: Because of their 'corrections' and over-processing, my hair is literally snapping off all the time. I have lost over 6 INCHES of length. In 30 years, I have NEVER hated my hair, but now I do. It’s gone from my waist to a broken, snapping chemical mess.

THE FINANCIAL LOSS & DISRESPECT: I have had to spend HUNDREDS OF POUNDS at another hairdresser for further corrections just to make this wearable, and the original salon refused to take any responsibility. They refused to refund a single penny and were extremely rude over messages calling me difficult for asking what they plan to do to fix their mistake. They also said 'what is wrong with you' because I said they had ruined my hair! They are incompetent, and they have no professional ethics. They will take your money, destroy your confidence, and then insult you for it. DO NOT RISK YOUR HAIR HERE.

First Image: Colour from first appointment.
Other Images: Colour from second appointment and 'correction'. (according to this salon it's the exact same result)

reviewList.text: I spontaneously looked for a good salon to get my roots touched up while on vacation. This salon was the best thing that could have happened to me. reviewList.text:
WARNING: If you’re a tourist planning to get your hair dyed in Da Nang, first ask yourself one important question:

“Am I emotionally and financially prepared to fly back every few months because every other salon will disappoint me after this?”

😭😂

I came in wanting a luxury beige bronde balayage and they ABSOLUTELY understood the assignment. The level of precision and meticulousness was honestly insane. They weren’t just “doing balayage” — they were literally engineering dimension strand by strand.

They:
• used airtouch techniques with blow dryers to separate shorter hairs
• worked with ultra-thin sections and foils
• selectively corrected warmer/orange sections instead of frying my whole head
• carefully blended shadow roots and lowlights for that expensive soft melt effect
• constantly checked the integrity of my hair throughout the process

At one point FIVE people were painstakingly going through my hair section by section to refine the colour consistency. I have never seen this level of detail before.

And despite the language barrier, they were SO patient and sweet. We basically survived the entire appointment through Google Translate 😂 but they still took the time to explain every step whenever I got curious or panicked about what was happening to my hair LOL.

The final result is EXACTLY the soft luxury beige bronde I wanted — dimensional, blended, glossy, and somehow still healthy after all that corrective work

I cannot believe this place is rated 5-stars. Counter staff was very kind and hospitable. But massage experience was not very pleasant.

I had 30mins shampoo + 30mins foot massage for VND340,000. Was supposed to start at 7.55pm. Lady turned on and off light, left the room and came back 10mins later. Started shampoo at 8pm only. Her pressure was good when massaging head but when shampooing my hair, she kept using her nails to scrub my scalp. I have sensitive scalp and when washing off the shampoo, it was painful. I didn’t say anything because I didn’t know how to tell her not to use their nails. So I don’t blame her because I didn’t communicate. But anyone who does hair properly would know that you shouldn’t use nails to scrub scalp.

After 20mins, she completed and asked me to sit down to blow dry my hair. My hair was still wet and tangled up, and she put so much oil to tame my hair instead of properly drying it. I took the shampoo service because my hair was all oily after walking under the sun. Instead of feeling refreshed, my hair felt so yucks because of all the oil! And she didn’t even dry my hair at all.

And when it came to foot massage, by the time foot massage started, it was 8.30pm already. So u expected foot massage ends 9pm. But NO, the lady massage my leg and put SO MUCH oil to glide on my lower leg only. But never really massage my feet. I pointed to my feet then she started to massage. She completed the massage at 8.45pm and I asked if it’s completed. They said I had another 5mins head and shoulder massage. I never asked for head and shoulder massage. I clearly paid 30mins foot massage.

In the end, my hair was left FULLY OILY AND STILL WET, and did not event have proper foot massage. Yes the cost is affordable but please do proper service and don’t cheat your customer’s time.

I am back in my hotel now and I had to shower my hair again to get rid of all the oil and my foot feels like it was not even massaged. It’s like I wasted my money here FOR NOTHING. I could have gone another place for proper service.

I CANNOT BELIEVE THIS PLACE IS 5 STARS WHEN I SEE SAME REVIEWS SHARING SAME BAD EXPERIENCE AS ME. 🤔

reviewList.text:
I had an exceptional experience at Hiếu Đẹp – Đà Nẵng. The doctor was incredibly patient, professional, and highly knowledgeable. She took the time to listen to my concerns, thoroughly explain my options, and answer all of my questions.
What impressed me most was her honesty and strong ethical standards. She could have easily recommended additional treatments that were unnecessary and profitable, but instead she focused only on what was truly needed. That level of integrity is rare and speaks volumes about the quality of care provided at this clinic.
I highly recommend Hiếu Đẹp – Đà Nẵng to anyone looking for trustworthy skincare advice and treatments. Thank you for the excellent care and professionalism.
reviewList.author: Nadia Farll

reviewList.text: My husband and I went here for facials. They scanned our skin before the treatment and sat down with us to explain our individualized results, which was very informative. The clinic was clean and sanitary but not the most private or relaxing. I also got microneedling and masseter Botox, both of which were completed in a professional and pain-free manner. I would definitely recommend coming here!
reviewList.author: K N

reviewList.text:
My first time coming here, a friend of mine recommended it and it was actually very pleasant, Hoa explain to me the pictures they took of my face to explain different things happening. Which was really good, she answered all my questions very patiently and very helpful!
They didn’t over sale me on different procedures, they were very straightforward in what was best for me.

The facial itself was very very good! I was satisfied with it. Just need to wait for a few days to see how my face is after it, but I am pretty sure it’s going to be good as the whole facial nothing felt out of the ordinary.

Thank you, I will come back again for my facial routine!
reviewList.author: Beverly Chen

reviewList.text:
Mixed feelings about this clinic.

At the beginning, the manager was friendly and professional, and the therapist who did my treatment was also very kind. She explained everything clearly and answered all my questions. I especially appreciated that she showed me the unopened needle packages and the RF device before starting. As a foreigner, hygiene and safety are extremely important to me, so this helped me trust the clinic. I also researched the RF machine and found that it is a good-quality device, which made me more comfortable paying a higher price compared to other places.

I paid around €180 for the treatments, which is expensive for Vietnam, so I expect not only good equipment and skilled staff, but also ethical and professional business practices. It is still too early to judge the results, so I will update this review in about a week.

Unfortunately, the experience changed when I was leaving. Before the procedure, I was told that I would get a discount if I left a Google review. I had no problem with that and I support public reviews, they are important so people know what to expect. However, I was not told that I would be required to write the review on the spot, at the reception.

When I said I would do the review later from home, the clinic owner stepped in and I was told that I would only receive the discount if I wrote the review immediately, while still inside the clinic. At that moment, my taxi was waiting outside, my payment was about to be proceseed, and I had just spent several hours in painful procedures. I was tired, hungry, and not in a position to negotiate or think clearly.

This felt like pressure, not a voluntary review. Being asked to write a public review while someone is watching over you does not allow for honesty or fairness, especially when the results of the treatment are not visible yet. In my opinion, this is not a trustworthy or ethical way to collect reviews. This review is written out of the comfort of my home.

Review edit:
I see some visible results after 6 days. The clinic checked on me several times. Didn’t have any bad reactions on my skin. Would recommend the clinic apart from the manager behavior. Rising with one star ⭐️ after a positive outcome.
reviewList.author: Ana Paraschiv

places.name: Bliss Spa & Shampoo - Hair Wash, Shampoo Danang - Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh

reviewList.text: Today I had an exhausting day and by chance I was walking around here and found this place. I had a massage and shampoo (for the first time). I felt very well taken care of from the beginning (welcomed with tea), through the middle (a great professional washing my hair and massaging my shoulders and arms very well), to the end (mango lassi and impeccably hydrated hair). I highly recommend this place!
reviewList.author: Lau Loretto

reviewList.text: Had hair shampoo, shoulder and neck massage here. It was great experience. The staff were well trained. A drink was prepared for me after the treatment. Some staff can speak English and we communicate well throughout the process. Worth for money.
reviewList.author: Penny Yee

reviewList.text: I had hair, neck, and shoulder shampoo massage and its so good. Plus they even gave me a fruit tea and mango yogurt which are cherry on top. Love the experience, will definitely come back here ❤️🤗 thank you Bliss Spa 💕
reviewList.author: Ronaliza Villezar

reviewList.text: I tried a Vietnamese-style hair wash near my hotel. It was a 90-minute session and cost only 400,000 VND. The package included a head massage, neck and shoulder massage, hand massage, and foot massage — totally worth it. The staff were really friendly and kept checking if I was comfortable. They also served snacks and drinks, including a strawberry smoothie.

places.name: V-Senses Wellness & Spa - Furama Resort Đà Nẵng
places.address: 103-105 Võ Nguyên Giáp, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: My partner and I booked a 90 minute full body massage and it was spectacular. Before we began we were quizzed on our massage preferences and we each received exactly what we wanted. Both of our masseurs were skilled, professional and the whole vibe of the place was very welcoming. The staff were all so kind and accommodating.
reviewList.author: Laura Mckenzie

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Furama Resort Danang, specifically at their V-Senses Wellness & Spa.

The booking and confirmation process was smooth and hassle-free. I decided to try their Hilot Therapy (Filipino massage), which is a new addition to their traditional Asian massage offerings, and I’m so glad I did.

An at the reception was incredibly warm and welcoming. She kindly suggested that I use the sauna and steam room before my treatment, which turned out to be a fantastic recommendation. It helped me fully unwind and prepared my body for the massage.

As for the Hilot Therapy, I absolutely loved it. Special thanks to my therapist, Trinh, for delivering one of the best massages I’ve ever had. Growing up, I wasn’t particularly fond of traditional “hilot” in the Philippines, as it’s often quite strong and typically done when you have a sprain, muscle strain, or are feeling unwell. However, the Hilot Therapy at V-Senses was a completely different experience — deeply relaxing yet still wonderfully therapeutic.

The heated banana leaf application was such a thoughtful and soothing touch, and the mild cupping truly elevated the entire treatment. I would highly recommend their Hilot Therapy to anyone with an active lifestyle who wants to relieve muscle tension while also calming the mind and body.

I will definitely be returning to V-Senses to try their other spa services and to simply relax in the beautifully ambient setting.
reviewList.author: Jyv Regis

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful self-care weekend at V-Senses Spa, Furama Resort Danang, even though I wasn’t staying at the hotel. From the booking confirmation to my arrival, everything reflected a tranquil, classic atmosphere that immediately made me feel relaxed and welcomed.

The spa space was incredibly quiet and peaceful, and I was greeted with a lovely cup of tea. I appreciated the thoughtful consultation, where I could customize the massage intensity and choose my preferred essential oil—I highly recommend Eternal Forest, which is gentle and deeply calming.

The treatment began with a herbal foot soak, sea salt exfoliation, and soothing massage, accompanied by soft boat-bell sounds. The therapists were warm and attentive, making the experience feel truly restorative. I also enjoyed both the warm and cool saunas, which were a perfect ending.

Everything was beautifully done, and I left feeling completely relaxed and rejuvenated. It was absolutely worth it, and I didn’t want to leave at all. Highly recommended
reviewList.author: Ana Ms

reviewList.text:
Hidden away in a secluded corner of thr resort, V-senses Wellness & Spa welcomes guests in a serene haven of complete relaxation and rejuvenation including a variety of massages and beauty treatments.

V-senses is an up-scaled Vietnam-made wellness brand with a focus on holistic and sustainable physical balance and improvement through mindful physical, psychological, and spiritual activities. Through harmonious combination of healthcare and nourishing organic diets, well-balanced physical exercise programs, V-senses strives to awaken beauty and health from within.
reviewList.author: Precious Quy Le

reviewList.text:
Thank you, V-Senses Wellness and Furama Resort Da Nang, for such a wonderful wellness experience at Furama Resort Da nang.
Everything was beautifully organized, and I truly enjoyed every moment. I appreciate the warm hospitality and positive energy from the entire team.
Looking forward to visiting again soon!
reviewList.author: Hop le dinh bich

places.name: Tun Beauty Salon & Spa
places.address: 238 Đ. Trần Hưng Đạo, An Hải

reviewList.text:
I cannot say enough good things about my experience at Tun Beauty! I have thin, fine hair that easily falls out due to an autoimmune disease, so finding a stylist I can truly trust is incredibly rare.
I originally came in wanting a cut just below my shoulders, but my master stylist, Bao, politely gave me his honest professional advice. Everything he said made complete sense for my hair type. I decided to trust his expertise entirely and gave him full control. I just told him I needed something low-maintenance with natural volume, since I’m a total "wash and go" girl.
Bao absolutely delivered! He gave me the perfect cut that suits me, boosts my hair's volume, and is so easy to style.
Huge shout-out to Hieu and Yen for assisting and making the whole experience so seamless and welcoming. If you have fine or challenging hair, go see Bao—he is a true professional!
reviewList.author: Nga T

reviewList.text: I walked in to Tun for a haircut and realized that they did perms too for a great price! I’ve always wanted the Korean style haircut and perm and Bao delivered exactly what I was looking for with his expertise! I was on a tight schedule and had to catch a flight, and the whole team jumped in to help me stay on time without ever rushing the quality. It was an amazing experience from start to finish, and I’d highly recommend this salon!
reviewList.author: Emily Xiao

reviewList.text: I had a great experience at Tun. We walked in without an appointment and the staff were really accommodating and professional. I got a hair wash and exfoliating treatment with Pi and she was fantastic. I ended up falling asleep during the head massage - it was THAT relaxing 😴😴😴The staff then walked me downstairs and I was greeted by Quoc, who gave me a smooth blow dry! My hair feels super soft and smooth☺️ thank you to the team at TunBeauty!!
reviewList.author: Celine Gurung

reviewList.text: Thank you, Tun Beauty Salon & Spa, for the 5-star service every single time! Special shoutout to Quoc and Kho for always taking such good care of us. This is truly my go-to place for any hair treatment. This time, I got to bring my mom all the way from the US, and she’s already loving it. We both felt so well taken care of. ❤️ 100% recommended!
reviewList.author: Kimberly Cayanan

reviewList.text:
Amazing talent for my acrylic nails done by Pi.
The salon is very clean, comfortable and quiet.
New furniture which are clean, all equipment used are sterile. Air conditioned as well which helps when you’re relaxing. I would recommend you visit the salon for nails and anything in between while in Danang.
reviewList.author: Ed Moore

places.name: Gội đầu dưỡng sinh Đà Nẵng - LaLien Spa Massage body

reviewList.text:
Service:
- When I visited, everyone I interacted with was friendly, and although they didn’t speak English and I don’t speak Vietnamese, we communicated using Google translator.
- Rating: 5/5

Atmosphere:
- The massage beds are comfortable.
- Everything is clean.
- During my massage they played some relaxing music.
- When required, to keep you cool, they have air conditioning and fans.
- Rating: 5/5

Service:
- 60 minute full body massage.
- My treatment started off with some fresh fruit and a bottle of water. I then got changed, and a lady washed my feet, then I was taken upstairs to the massage beds, where my full body massage began. Once finished, I was escorted downstairs, where I was given a menu where I could choose a complimentary drink.
- Although I only booked the standard body massage, I’m pleased to say they also used hot stones, which felt great and was very much appreciated.
- A special thank you to my masseuse, Too Ten Xuan a, who was absolutely amazing! Highly recommend!
- Price: 300K
- Rating: 5/5

If you’re looking a great massage at a reasonable price, I highly recommend La Lien Spa.

Overall Rating: 5/5
reviewList.author: Steve Hilton

reviewList.text:
This was my very first massage in Da Nang and since there is so many options I did not expect much. Travis from Da Nang Social Club recommended this place for a hair spa/wash and I was like ok, hopefully they do good massage too, let's see🫠

But what I received?!!!😍 45 minutes of an absolute BLISS super strong back massage with hot stones, head massage front/back, my massuse Tha (she is tiny but so strong and knows what she's doing, wow!) exactlty knew what spots to focus on, the pressure was absolutely amazing & strong and as Im writing this review Im here with a free pineapple juice, in a nice calm atmoshphere, and I feel soooo relaxed and my trapese are 100% softer and lighter.

I got so lucky finding Tha as the first massage therapist in Da Nang it feels illegal!🤣

I will only go to her from now on.

So grateful, 5/5, highly recommend!!!! THIS IS IT (and i am a massage pro - even lived in Bali and this was better!)
reviewList.author: Martiny Tomash

reviewList.text: Great experience overall. Tha was a fantastic therapist - very good massage, and very relaxing and professional. I went for the 90 minute head spa, which included a facial, neck and shoulder massage and foot massage. Included a fresh juice at the end - lovely!!
reviewList.author: Rosie Woulfe

reviewList.text:
I highly recommend this spa! 🤍

I tried the 90-minute hot stone massage and honestly had such a great experience.

First of all, the atmosphere was so peaceful, cozy, and relaxing. The moment I walked in, I already felt calmer 😌

My therapist was ms. Hoang, and she was amazing! She has really strong hands and clearly knows what she’s doing. The pressure was perfect, the massage techniques felt very professional, and the hot stone treatment was incredibly relaxing.

What I liked most was that she kept checking if the pressure was okay and made sure I was comfortable throughout the session. She was also very friendly and easy to talk to. If you’re coming here, definitely book with Ms. Hoang! ❤️

I’m 100% a local, not a tourist, so trust me on this one 😂 I’ve tried plenty of massage places in Da Nang already

I’ll definitely be back again, even though it’s quite far from my house hahahaa!
reviewList.author: Yến Thuận

reviewList.text: One of my best massages ever! I feel like all my sore muscles were treated. My masseuse constantly asks if I'm good. Lots of complimentary snacks and drinks, as well, before and after my massage. Would recommend!!

attribution.name: Gội đầu dưỡng sinh Đà Nẵng - LaLien Spa Massage body

reviewList.text: What a relaxing experience! We started with an amazing foot scrub and then shampoo and relax package and a four hands massage. It was relaxing, professional, and very clean. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Allysse Ivetic

reviewList.text:
My wife and I came to Mew Spa twice, and both visits were excellent. We tried the full body massage, ear wax cleaning, and hair spa, and every service was done with great care and professionalism.
The staff were very kind and genuinely caring, always attentive and making sure we were comfortable throughout the entire experience. Their massage technique was truly on point—relaxing, well-balanced, and clearly done by experienced therapists. Everything felt clean, calming, and thoughtfully handled from start to finish.
We left each time feeling refreshed and well taken care of. The consistency between visits really stood out. If we are back in the area, we will definitely return and highly recommend Mew Spa to anyone looking for quality service and a relaxing experience.
reviewList.author: Patrick H.

reviewList.text: I had a very pleasant experience here. The service was excellent, and the staff were friendly, attentive, and professional. I came for a hair wash and head massage, and it was relaxing, with the right amount of pressure, helping to relieve tension and leaving me feeling refreshed and rejuvenated.
reviewList.author: Serene Ooh

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful and relaxing spa experience in Da Nang. The massage was excellent, and the complimentary foot cleaning was a thoughtful touch. The staff were warm, attentive, and professional, while the manager went above and beyond to provide personalized care and ensure every guest felt welcome. I also appreciated the complimentary water, yogurt snack, and fresh oranges after the treatment. The outstanding service and hospitality made this a truly memorable experience. I highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Edwin Saramosing

reviewList.text: We had a lovely afternoon.  The girls were charming, friendly, and did wonderful work.  My husband felt so peaceful he took a nap and woke up feeling refreshed.  I received wonderful a massage of hands, feet, and most importantly neck area.  Plus the hair washing was divine.  A quaint little shop, absolutely worth a visit.
reviewList.author: Michelle

places.name: Nón Spa - Massage, Nail, Hair Washing, Facial and Skin care

reviewList.text:
Non Spa in the An Thuong area of Da Nang was an excellent experience. The location is perfect—right in the heart of the tourist area, making it easy to visit after dinner or a long day at the beach.

The atmosphere was calm, clean, and very relaxing. The massage was top-quality, with skilled therapists who knew exactly how to relieve tension and fatigue. I left feeling completely refreshed.

What I really liked was the balance between professionalism and comfort. It felt well-managed and consistent, which is not always easy to find in busy tourist areas.

If you’re staying around An Thuong and looking for a reliable and high-quality massage, this place is definitely worth it. Highly recommended.

reviewList.text:
Visited there three times during my 5-day trip in Da Nang. Massage service is excellent, the power is just right. Me and my husband got a private room. It’s very nice to have hair massage before sleep. And there are different massage packages and combinations for selection.
Can book in advance through whatsapp. Staff respond fast.
Will visit again if I travel to Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Zimmer DA

reviewList.text:
International Women’s Day so I treated My Lady.
She was very satisfied, (as was I, playing pool with the lads all afternoon!!)
Didn’t know before I booked in advance that they offered 5% discount so a bonus right there.

I highly recommend this place. If it worked for M’Lady, it can work for all the ladies.  😛😏

reviewList.text: Excellent spa. Very clean and well run with lovely staff. The 90 minute hot stone massage was excellent, as was the 45 min facial and 45 min foot massage. Great location in An Thong 3 and very reasonable priced. Book via what’s app as they are busy, which is a good sign.
reviewList.author: Vicki Reckling

reviewList.text:
I had a wonderful experience at Non Spa today. I booked a hair washing treatment that also included a mini facial, and the whole session lasted about an hour. It was incredibly relaxing—I actually fell asleep!

A big thank you to Loan for the lovely treatment, and also to the front desk staff who kindly helped me find the spa. I really appreciated the warm and professional service.

I will definitely be coming back again!
