reviewList.text:
I visited Noah Spa, which was conveniently located beside my hotel. With no prior expectations, I opted for their premium stone massage package.  I can confidently say that I had the best massage ever.

During my four-night stay in Danang, I visited Noah Spa on my second night and ended up spending three consecutive nights there.
I wish Noah Spa could expand and open more branches so that more people could experience their exceptional service.

Hats off to the young couple who own the spa for their efforts in providing outstanding service. They deserve to open a training facility to share their expertise.

Special thanks to my therapist, Vuong, and the entire team for their soulful service.
reviewList.author: Aileen Catindig

reviewList.text:
I decided to stop by to see if they could fit me in for a foot massage, and I was accomodated on the spot. The friendly receptionist Jeannie made me feel welcome,and explained all the options for my massage very clearly.  I was also able to add my neck and shoulders to be massaged, as well as my legs and feet. My massage therapist Vuoung was very skillful, and applied just the right pressure to my aching muscles. It was one one of the best massages I've had so far in Da Nang.
The facilities are very calm, quiet, clean, and is surrounded by beautiful Buddhist statues.
In contrast to other spas in Da Nang, I wasn't pressured to immediately write a review as is very common with other big spas here. I appreciated that very much.
Thank you for a wonderful experience today!
reviewList.author: the real JeannieP

reviewList.text: 35 percent off if you pay by card and 40 percent if you pay by cash! They are slightly cheaper than the other spas but i would say the lady who helped me massaged was really good. I feel much relaxed right now! Other spas provide after spa treats/ snacks but they offer only tea, and also a glass of tea before your spa session. The receptionist could speak in English which was amazing! You have to pay before your session (i was pretty surprised about this but it was fine). Overall was very clean too! You’ll have your locker in the room so you’ll feel much safer!
reviewList.author: Deborah Kay

reviewList.text: Best massage ever! It was a great experience! Strongly recommend. Also utilize happy hour ;)
reviewList.author: Mingoo Kim

reviewList.text:
I did a foot + leg massage. It was just wrong with unskilled finger placement and probably the worst massage I've had in VN. She missed the toes till I pointed it out to her.

I also had to supervise her finger placement around the ankle several times and it was as if giving a tutorial on how to a job she's paid to do.

I kept my cool but at one point she left the room with the door open, to fetch a towel.

Compared to other spas in VN, this was just not worth it.

As a practice, they ask you to pay the fee and tip upfront. Yep, they insist on a tip!

You can find much cheaper massages at other areas that are a lot better massages. And also those that are more expensive massages and highly skilled. But this one at Noah Spa was a let down.
reviewList.author: Sheila Kaur

reviewList.text: Traveling to Da Nang and wanted to find a hair salon nearby for a quick hair dye and stumbled upon this hair salon near the hotel. My overall experience was pleasant! The owner of the hair salon explained the process thoroughly and I appreciated how he went through the cost to confirm with me beforehand. He made the effort to communicate and gave me a truly personable experience. The owner has many years of experience and you can definitely tell he takes ownership for the quality of his work. His assistants were also amazing and are very friendly. Highly recommend this salon for anyone visiting the area for professional haircuts and hair coloring. I will visit again when I’m traveling to Da Nang!
reviewList.author: l Einna

reviewList.text:
Permanent straightening-
Such a great experience! The staff were kind, knowledgeable, and very efficient—my daughter’s straight perm was done in just 3 hours. The owner was honest and upfront about pricing, which I loved. No wonder this place has such high ratings!
reviewList.author: Julie Pham

reviewList.text: I can’t stress how much I am in love with my new hair style and color. Duoc is truly a master at his craftsmanship. He and his wife life took good care of my hair from start to finish.  Duoc brought my hair back to life. He is genuinely the sweetest stylist I have ever met. I highly recommend him and the services he provides 10 Stars for sure!!!
reviewList.author: Bella Sera

reviewList.text:
Perfect trim, honest work, and a salon I will absolutely return to ✨ I was very nervous to get my hair cut in Vietnam because I’m extremely particular about my hair and have had bad experiences even in the U.S. with stylists cutting too much, over-layering, or taking creative liberties that changed what I asked for. So I did a lot of research before choosing this salon by carefully looking through client photos, especially of women with long, healthy hair and clean edge work 💗

I came prepared with a translated note explaining exactly what I wanted and also showed them one of their own haircut photos to demonstrate the edge finish I was looking for. They immediately understood, respected my natural waves (no pushing straightening or treatments), and took me right away. 🙏

The stylist showed me the length she would cut, I approved it, and she cut exactly that amount - about 1.5–2 inches - nothing more, nothing less. The cut took only 5 mins, which I appreciated, because I wanted a simple straight trim with very light blending at the edges - not unnecessary layers or over-styling. They delivered exactly what I asked for, and that built real trust for me. ✨

As a former model who has had professional haircuts around the world, I can confidently say that the best experience is when a stylist listens and executes precisely, and that is exactly what they did here.

They also genuinely went out of their way to try to help me find a hair growth product even arranging for one to be couriered to the salon, and although it wasn’t exactly what I was looking for, I truly appreciated the extra care and effort they made. 🤍

It has been several days since my cut and it looks good in different hair styles and after washing. I will absolutely be returning here and recommending this salon to anyone looking for honest, skillful, no-nonsense haircuts in Da Nang. 💇‍♀️✨
reviewList.author: Sofia Wakabayashi

reviewList.text:
I had an excellent experience at this hair salon and couldn’t be more satisfied with the results. The staff were not only highly skilled and professional, but also genuinely attentive to my preferences and needs. They took the time to give thoughtful advice while still respecting my personal style, which made me feel confident and well taken care of.

The atmosphere was clean, comfortable, and welcoming, creating a very relaxing experience from start to finish. The attention to detail, precision in their work, and use of quality products really stood out. My hair turned out even better than I expected, and I’ve received many compliments since.

If you’re looking for a reliable place with talented stylists and excellent service, I highly recommend this salon. I will definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Leo Boss

reviewList.text: Lovely experience… staff were so accommodating and friendly … I had 1 hour foot massage and it was very relaxing … I hadn’t booked, I just walked in and then fitted me in … welcome drink and cookies plus a tea and fruit after treatment …
reviewList.author: Houston Lani

reviewList.text: Very comfy, clean environment and really friendly staffs. Dessert after massage is greattttt
reviewList.author: YS N

reviewList.author: Cynthia Tan

reviewList.author: Edith K

The staff is so friendly and they speak english well. The treatment was amazing, my hair feels so soft.
They are cautious and ask during the treatment if everything is fine, so they are able to adjust anything to make it more comfortable for you.
Please go and visit!

Amazing salon experience in Vietnam!
I really loved my haircut. The service was relaxing and professional, the shampoo treatment and massage were excellent, and Du did an amazing job. The atmosphere was calm, comfortable, and perfect for relaxing. I was very happy with the result and will definitely come back again. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Christina Schaaf

reviewList.text: I had a great experience . Ive cut my hair before in Vietnam.  But this time my hair had grown quite long and needed a serious cut . Phan Thanh Sang cut my hair exactly how I wanted it. I showed him a picture and he also recommended.layers which I did. He made me feel more happier and feeling lighter. Made me feel fabulous.
reviewList.author: Preeya Mistry

reviewList.text:
I had a haircut, perm and keratin treatment done here. With the treatment they also did a neck and shoulder massage which was much appreciated after sitting for 4 hours. Service could be improved, only one of the guys (brunette?) regularly checked in with me. I also wish they explained the steps because I didn’t know how long the process would take. They also provided a small water bottle and a slice of packaged cake.

However, at the end of the day the hair result is the most important part of the salon. I appreciate them being honest about the result I would get and I quite like it. Price is very reasonable. I recommend this place for your hair needs, just bring Google Translate to fully communicate what you want.
reviewList.author: Liane Vuong

reviewList.text:
I had my black hair transformed to a grey color here, and I knew it would be a very challenging process because my hair is super thick and dense, and I had previously dyed it. But the whole team did an amazing job. They were incredibly patient, gentle, and thoughtful throughout the entire process, and they explained every step to me.
They even gave me a relaxing head massage after the coloring, which I loved.
You can also order great healthy drinks while you wait.
Just make sure you plan enough time, because the process can take a while — but it’s absolutely worth it!
reviewList.author: Mahshid Talebi

reviewList.text:
Hair wash and massage was outstanding.

At first, I was happy with my cut on my curly hair but after it dried I was actually quite sad. It probably doesn't help that it was a huge change from long to short but I did ask for it to be medium length and showed a photo where the ladies hair dry was to her collar bone. They did try check if the length was okay but then he would go back in and trim is slightly shorter for the layers, so I think this made it even shorter than when he originally asked and it just dried too short.

Also, they didn't check that my hair was even lengths at the end and one side is shorter than the other.

They did use a diffuser to lightly dry my hair but left it wet still, which made it frizzy and hard to see the unevenness and shortness.

Overall, it's not a bad cut for the money and the hair wash was superb. But the cut could have been better and I don't like how they ask and watch you as you review them, makes me think that some of the reviews maybe aren't genuine.

Recommend!

reviewList.text:
Our family of four had a wonderful experience today at Rosa Spa Da Nang! We all got the full body treatment, including the head, legs, feet, and shoulder massage, and every single one of us left feeling completely relaxed.
​What really stood out to us was how incredibly accommodating and helpful the staff were with our son, who is in a wheelchair. They made sure he was perfectly comfortable and went above and beyond to ensure he had a great experience.
​A special shoutout to Lant, who gave me my massage she was so nice, professional, and provided excellent service!
​If you are looking for a high-quality massage with fantastic, caring service in Da Nang, this is the place to go. We will definitely be back!

reviewList.text: Just had a full body massage at Rosa Spa. Highly recommended. You’ll get medicinal herbal soup afterwards.

reviewList.text: I had an excellent massage with Kim 58. The massage was very relaxing and professional, and Kim clearly knows what they’re doing. The pressure was just right, and they focused on the areas that needed it most. I felt much better afterward—looser, calmer, and refreshed. I would definitely recommend Kim 58 to anyone looking for a quality massage experience.
reviewList.author: Shivangi Gupta

places.name: Lite Retreat Spa & Nail ( Shampoo - Waxing - Take Ear )

reviewList.text:
I’ve been to this massage place three times now, and every single visit has been exceptionally high-quality — never once disappointed. They pay attention to every little detail, making you feel truly welcomed and well taken care of, almost like VIP treatment at home.
Each therapist is seriously skilled; the technique is precise, professional, and effective. Every time I walk out, my body feels completely renewed, light, and relaxed — like I got a full reset.
In my opinion, this is hands-down the best massage experience in Da Nang, Vietnam. If you’re in the area, do not miss it. Easily worth every penny and more.
Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Louis

reviewList.text:
I had foot massage and manicure (nails) done and it was amazing. The massage was so good, relaxing and the therapist actually did massage on my foot, where most places we have been they massage more the legs than the foot itself. Super recommend. My husband had a full body massage and loved too.

I ended up having my nails done, gel. And seriously she was so calm, attentive to details. Even better than I have in Australia, she was so delicate and sweet. So professional!!!
The reception girls were so sweet giving us treats and tea, all the time around checking if we were comfortable.

Only thing that bothered me a little was that when I was having my foot massage another guy came in to have a treatment in the room on my side and he was all the time watching loudly something on his phone and talking. That ended up distracting and disturbing but was not the spa fault, is the education from some people that go missing sometimes.

I really recommend this place! 10/10
reviewList.author: Morgana Lamb

reviewList.text: My wife and I had their couples massage. We came in before lunch time and there were no other customers. Overall experience was great and the therapists were very attentive, knowledgeable, and helpful. We both had their traditional Vietnamese massage. It was our first time and it felt like it’s a mix of Swedish and Thai massage that we’ve had before. We were in the same room. Both beds are clean and comfortable and smelled really nice and relaxing. The front office attendant is likewise very friendly and immediately made us comfortable with drinks while waiting for the therapists. Go check them out and you will not be disappointed.
reviewList.author: Eduard Lu Jr

reviewList.text: This was the best massage of my entire trip to Vietnam! I had the full-body course, and it truly worked every single muscle. They started with my legs, smoothly moved up to my back, and finished with relaxing my head and neck. The feeling is indescribable you can tell the therapists really know what they're doing and understand the body. After the session, I felt like I was floating instead of walking. Thank you so much for your golden hands! I will definitely come back. Highly recommend to all tourists!
reviewList.author: Татьяна Колодняк

reviewList.text: INCREDIBLE.   We have come here a few times since finding it.  Oil massages, nails, feet, head massages, and we just tried the shampoo treatments.  All 5 star quality.

reviewList.text: Great Thai styled massage. One of the best I have had on this trip. The reception staff were lovely. They were able to fit us in last minute. The rooms were clean. would recommend.
reviewList.author: Connor Langton

reviewList.text: Danang is full of so many spas it’s impossible to choose. Hopefully this review will make it easy…From the door greeting to the farewell, the staff at Da Spa were so gracious and kind, and non-aggressive or pushy like all the other places. We came in too late to get the 90 minute massage that we had been looking for but the wonderful hostess Vy Vo suggested a shorter more targeted massage. We were led to a modern and tastefully furnished room for two,  comfortably cool given the suffocating heat outside and soothingly scented. Our neck shoulder and nape massage was one of the best I have ever had, better than in Europe, US, and South Korea. Afterwards, we were treated with such pampering care, with a nourishing treat and rest, before we went back out into the bustle and heat that is Da Nang in July. This spa is a true oasis in the city…we plan to return as many times as we can during the rest of our trip!
reviewList.author: Sue Sejda

reviewList.text: Best massage in da nang! 10/10 customer service and plenty of snacks provided. Will definitely be coming back

I will definitely come back again, loved it!

reviewList.text: We had a phenomenal experience at this spa. I live in thailand and am surrounded by massages so I can be quite picky, but this location really exceeded my expectations. I don’t think the staff looked exhausted, just inexperienced.

I’ll definitely be coming back and recommending this place to my friends. A spot truly worth visiting for a relaxing escape! 💆‍♂️✨

reviewList.text: Amazing service! I got a European styled facial because I felt as I was breaking out so much while in Vietnam. This facial was amazing. Though it was red and inflamed for a few days after, the following week my skin was so glowy and fresh! Definitely recommend this for a detox and reset. Staff is so sweet and helpful. While procedure takes about 1.5- 2 hrs, so allow at least for 2 hrs in your schedule. Facilities and space is also so clean and amazingly curated. A must if you are in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: Mariel C

reviewList.text: I am female but share this google account with my husband hence why it says stuart. I visited Havi spa today for diode laser hair removal on my  chin and full bikini.  The staff made me feel very comfortable and I had a painless experience. The therapist Tina, was lovely and very thorough and made multiple passes over the treatment areas. She regularly checked I was not needing the energy level switched down . I think i can go higher next time.  The spa is very hygienic. The reception Manager was lovely,  she gave me a bottle of water, after care advice and spoke excellent English. I will definitely return for more treatments.  Thank you  ladies 🤩 😊👍
reviewList.author: Stuart

reviewList.text:
The best facial I have ever had ❤️ I had “ Hyaluronic acid & RF” and my skin feels so good  🌺 the before and after service was amazing. I contacted Havi beforehand and asked about their services and got a reply back explaining what services were available. The facial itself was really relaxing (first time when I actually didn’t feel extractions). I got a message with after care instructions and they also contacted me the day after to check how my skin was 😊

Havi is super clean, staff speak good English and it was just so nice experience. They use genuine products and you feel confident and comfortable with the whole process . At the end I got a lovely surprise with flower for Vietnam Woman’s Day ❤️

I will be back to try their massage ❤️

I can truly recommend Havi - definitely worth   It 🌟
reviewList.author: Anna

reviewList.text:
Excellent service from start to finish. I was very warmly welcomed, and the communication was smooth and professional.
The consultant took the time to carefully analyze my skin and recommend exactly what my face needed, without pressure. The therapist was also excellent, I could feel the difference in my skin immediately after the treatment.
As a lovely surprise, I was even given a coupon as a Christmas gift, which I really appreciated.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for professional, attentive care and visible results.

reviewList.text: Very very good massage experience 👍🏻 they will do a questionnaire on which parts you want to focus before massage. Can choose your own aroma oil also. Very very comfortable. Highly recommended 👍🏻 They even serve tea and dessert after massage.

reviewList.text:
I had such a relaxing experience at this spa.
The massage was gentle, professional, and truly helped me unwind after a long day.
What made this place extra special is that they have adorable pets around 🐶🐱
Having furry friends nearby instantly made the atmosphere warmer, calmer, and more comforting.
It honestly felt like a healing space, not just a normal spa.
Highly recommended if you’re looking for both relaxation and positive vibes ✨
reviewList.author: nhi lâm

reviewList.text:
After getting our booking declined from famous spas, I finally found this place and messaged them through WhatsApp.
Transaction was smooth and fast. They even offered a free pick up service! Within 40mins from my inquiry, we were picked up and brought to their spa, welcomed with warm and friendly smiles from staff. Bonus presence from furry friends made the whole experience such a delight!
If you need late night massage, this is perfect as they open til 4am. We got the Healing Shampoo which was an hour of head and shoulder massage and hair wash. The girl who attended to me (sorry I didn’t get her name) was patient enough and constantly checked if i was okay as I find some steps ticklish and couldn’t help but let out a laugh 😂.
Sweet treats such as tea and yogurt were served after. Left the place feeling relaxed with really clean and soft hair! Oh, did I mention the owner was nice and friendly too? 😊
reviewList.author: Irish D

reviewList.text:
I visited recently and had the head‑shoulder massage, leg massage and ear cleaning. The staff were polite and welcoming, and the place was clean and peaceful. The ear cleaning was done well — gentle, careful and exactly how I like it.

However, the massages didn’t quite meet my expectations. The pressure was lighter than I prefer, and some areas felt a bit rushed or not worked deeply enough — especially my tight shoulders and legs. Overall it was still a decent experience, just not as thorough or firm as I hoped.

A little more attention to adjusting pressure and spending extra time on key tension points would make a big improvement. Thank you for the service.

I recently enjoyed the Signature 120-Minute Package at Ara Spa, and it was one of the most relaxing experiences I’ve had in Vietnam.

The journey began with a 15-minute traditional Vietnamese herbal bath. The warm herbal water helped me unwind immediately and prepared my body for the treatment ahead. After that, I spent 15 minutes in the sauna, which was perfect for releasing tension and leaving me feeling refreshed.

The highlight of the experience was the 90-minute full-body massage. My therapist was highly skilled, attentive, and adjusted the pressure perfectly to my needs. Every muscle felt relieved, and I could feel the stress melting away throughout the session.

To complete the experience, Ara Spa served a traditional Vietnamese chicken soup after the treatment. It was warm, comforting, and exactly what my body needed after such a relaxing massage.

From the welcoming staff to the peaceful atmosphere and excellent service, every detail was thoughtfully prepared. I left feeling completely rejuvenated, refreshed, and energized.

I highly recommend Ara Spa to anyone looking for a premium wellness experience in Vietnam. I will definitely return on my next visit.

reviewList.text:
Honestly, I never wanted to leave a review because I just wanted the salon to be empty so I could book appointments for hair washes without waiting.

The salon is tucked away in a cute little alley. I stumbled upon it by chance, and since then, I've visited once a week on weekends to relax. The salon isn't big and only has 3 beds, so I recommend booking in advance or calling to avoid waiting.
The biggest plus is the incredibly attentive staff, always speaking softly and asking questions (I've tested two staff members and the owner, and they all gave great massages). Another thing I love is the super dark, quiet atmosphere, which is really hard to find.

My two usual prices are 79 and 125. I've recommended it to family and friends, and everyone agrees that 125 is the best option for a full service experience. 79 is also good, but I often choose 125 because it includes more services.

I honestly never wanted to leave a review because I just wanted to avoid waiting. In short, it's a place I'm absolutely addicted to. I've had my hair washed many times, and each time I feel treated like the first time. Sometimes they even give me extra treats on holidays. But I still hope the salon fails because I don't want to miss out on my weekend hair wash slot, huhu.

reviewList.text: I am very satisfied with the spa's service; it was a memorable experience during my trip to Da Nang. The staff were enthusiastic and very professional, and the clean space created a relaxing and peaceful atmosphere.
reviewList.author: Lan Ngọc

reviewList.text: I happened to walk into this salon to wash my hair, but I was truly impressed by the professionalism and service of the staff. I highly recommend it! The face mask was also high quality, and my body felt refreshed after using it. 💕💕💯💯💯
reviewList.author: Nhi Kieu

attribution.name: Tiệm làm da Hana & Gội đội dưỡng sinh
Tiệm làm da Hana & Gội đội dưỡng sinh
Tiệm làm da Hana & Gội đội dưỡng sinh

reviewList.text: The service was excellent, and the staff were very enthusiastic. I'll definitely be coming back often ❤️
reviewList.author: Thị Thu Đỗ

reviewList.text: Efficient service, clear customer consultation; I brought a friend there yesterday.
reviewList.author: Bui Hoa

reviewList.text: The service was effective. I'll bring my daughter there for a hair removal treatment in a few days.
reviewList.author: Thao Pham

reviewList.text: The staff are enthusiastic. This reputable spa is worth returning to many more times.
reviewList.author: Tài Trần

reviewList.text: I was introduced here by a friend... I rate it highly compared to other places... the manager is enthusiastic, the staff are quick and efficient... after the hair removal sessions, my skin became smoother... the dark spots also disappeared... I will recommend my friends to come and support them...
reviewList.author: Hieu Thai

places.name: NHÃ SPA - Gội đầu dưỡng sinh và Spa chăm sóc da

reviewList.text: A professional, competent, and friendly masseuse. I had a delightful foot and head massage.
reviewList.author: Dirard Mikdad

reviewList.text:
The beauty massage here is the real deal. I went three times a week. Women will probably like it even more because of the skincare. It's one-fifth the price of Korea.

It was the best massage I had in Da Nang.
reviewList.author: 김호준

reviewList.text: A 90-minute hot stone massage costs 350,000 VND. The price is reasonable, and the owner's meticulous massage was excellent. My aching body felt refreshed after the massage. The owner is very kind, and I hope your business prospers even more in the future!
reviewList.author: 여한지선

reviewList.text:
I wanted to get some skin care, so I searched Google and found this place. As the reviews suggested, it was a one-person shop run by someone who seemed to be the owner, a skin care specialist. Since I had a reservation for two, one masseuse arrived later. One for the skin care, the other for the full body massage.
I was very satisfied with the skin care. They meticulously removed blackheads from all over my face, and they even switched between different machines throughout the service. They even cleaned my ears and gave me a quick massage.
I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for something other than a full body massage. It felt like I was in heaven for a moment.
reviewList.author: mandu bu (mandubu)

reviewList.text:
I booked the 90-minute combo course to get some skincare. The price is good, and the service is excellent.

Since it's a local shop, the facilities aren't state-of-the-art, but they do their best and work hard.

I received a sebum removal treatment.

It started with a thorough shave~~

Hmm, there's a lot of sebum!

Please show me a photo later haha.

Make sure to make a reservation via KakaoTalk before visiting.

It's a spa worth visiting for a treatment.

The owner is also very friendly.
reviewList.author: Bongchol Lee

places.name: Maylis Paris Spa & Massage Da Nang
places.address: Toà nhà FUTA Residence, 196-198 Võ Nguyên Giáp, An Hải

reviewList.text: We are very satisfied with the service and level of this beauty salon! This is a different level and professionalism! Well done! Thank you all for taking care of my daughter and me!
reviewList.author: Olga Cherneta

reviewList.text:
My wife and I had an amazing experience at this beauty salon. From the moment we arrived, we were warmly welcomed and made to feel comfortable. The entire team was friendly, professional, and genuinely attentive.

One thing that really stood out was their impressive selection of modern, high-tech equipment. They have some of the latest beauty machines that you rarely see elsewhere, which shows their commitment to offering the best treatments and staying at the forefront of the industry.

A very special thanks to May, the owner, who made us feel incredibly welcome. She was kind, caring, and took the time to ensure we had the best possible experience. Her passion and dedication truly make a difference.

We both left feeling extremely satisfied and would highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for top-quality treatments, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional customer service. We will definitely be coming back!
reviewList.author: Geoffrey

reviewList.text: The best massage in Danang, the best understandable people there ❤️
reviewList.author: JJ Amine

reviewList.text: I sent a message on WhatsApp at 10:30am this morning for an appointment to get a lash lift, and the response was so fast. I went in at 11am, and Yen did an amazing job with my lashes. I’m so happy! They came out beautiful.
reviewList.author: Sue Oh

reviewList.text:
Very beautiful spa center in Da nang center, very relax massage in a super parfume center , very relax .
Super recommend.
reviewList.author: Benedetto

attribution.name: Maylis Paris Spa & Massage Da Nang
Maylis Paris Spa & Massage Da Nang
Maylis Paris Spa & Massage Da Nang

reviewList.text:
Highly recommend!!

This Spa is a hidden gem. The staff is very welcoming, friendly and professional.
The services are top notch and the prices are very reasonable!

We’ll definitely be coming back here!
reviewList.author: Hossam (Sam)

reviewList.text:
If you're looking for a spa near Man Thai Beach, head over to 132 Le Van Thu, Son Tra, Da Nang.
I was quite tired after a swim and happened to find this newly opened spa while walking around the area, so I decided to give it a try.
Affordable pricing is great, but the service here is beyond amazing—not only cheap but also very attentive.
A small suggestion: you should install a doorbell so you can welcome guests more promptly when they walk in.
Since it's a new spa, everything is fresh and spotlessly clean.
Wishing the spa lots of customers! I’ll definitely be back on my next trip. 😍
reviewList.author: lan linh

reviewList.text:
Honestly one of the best hair spa experiences I’ve had. The staff were super gentle and friendly, the whole place felt really relaxing, and the head massage was sooo good 😭

What surprised me most is the price — way cheaper than many places nearby but the service was honestly even better. You can tell they really care about customers instead of just rushing through everything.

Definitely coming back again. Highly recommend if you want to relax and treat yourself a little ✨
reviewList.author: Tấn Đức Võ

reviewList.text: I had a fantastic experience here getting a pink gel set on hands and feet, beautiful staff, clean environment with air conditioning which is a perfect way to beat the heat, 10/10 paint job. I would definitely recommend this salon and it is super close to the beach. Great prices and deals
reviewList.author: Loane B

reviewList.text: Had a good experience getting waxed at Hi Spa. The staff were friendly and made me feel comfortable. The process was quick and not as painful as I expected. Everything was clean and professional. Would come back again!
reviewList.author: Thanh Bui

places.name: Massage - Gội ��ầu thư giãn Thảo My

reviewList.text: I went for a body massage and foot scrub. The owner and the young staff member were very enthusiastic and thorough. Compared to other places, I found the prices here much cheaper, but the quality was excellent. Everyone should try it! 😊
reviewList.author: Minh Huyền

reviewList.text: The salon offers affordable prices, a very relaxing hair wash and neck/shoulder massage, and the owner is friendly and enthusiastic ❤️😘
reviewList.author: Kim Ngân Ngô trần

reviewList.text: Getting a haircut and a relaxing hair wash was great. The owner and staff were super enthusiastic and lovely.
reviewList.author: Anh Nguyễn Thị Phương

reviewList.text: Reasonable prices, reliable quality, and enthusiastic service.
reviewList.author: Ly Trần

attribution.name: Massage - Gội đầu thư giãn Thảo My
Massage - Gội đầu thư giãn Thảo My

reviewList.text:
coming 1-2 times in a month. amazing massage, amazing people. owner is very hospitable and cares about guests a lot! beautiful place and convenient location.
highly recommend!
reviewList.author: sergei german

reviewList.text: I’ve had a massage and hair shampoo here. Both services were great. Staff is attentive and listening to the needs. Pricing is also good! I had a great reset after 2 busy days!
reviewList.author: Kamila Srokosz

reviewList.text: This place is the best price / value. The quality is the same with others expensive spa but the price is affordable. Highly recommend getting a 90minutes here, me and my girlfriend loves being here
reviewList.author: The Offcial of Tom

reviewList.text: Great relaxing full body massage! 250k - 60 min, 350k - 90 min. For this price it’s the best place to rest :)
reviewList.author: Evgenii Petukhov

reviewList.text: Great experience and massage here though the room was a little noisy due to the neighbours beside. But the massage was relaxing with enough pressure. The staff even surprised us with a cake for birthday celebration. Will be back again next time!
reviewList.author: Felicia Lee (Fel)

reviewList.text:
All aesthetics, poor quality.

The spa itself was very beautiful and visually pleasing, but unfortunately the service did not match the appearance at all. My family of four booked 90-minute massages and were split into two rooms, with two people in each room. We were brought to our room around 6:30, but the massage did not actually begin until around 6:50. My massage ended around 7:50, meaning I essentially paid for a 90-minute massage and only received about 60 minutes.

My brother and I came downstairs first, while our parents did not come down until around 8:20. When we questioned the timing, the staff tried to claim that our parents took a long time to change, which was an excuse to cover up the fact that our massages had ended early.

On top of that, I had specifically noted on the form before the massage that I wanted focus on my upper body. However, during the full-body massage, almost no attention was given to my neck, head, shoulders, or back until the last 10 minutes. I had to explicitly stop the massage and ask the masseuse to focus on those areas.

For 3,200,000 VND, I was extremely disappointed, especially considering the spa’s reviews. You can get a much better massage, for the full amount of time you paid for, at a fraction of the price elsewhere. I almost never leave reviews, but this experience was bad enough that I felt I had to.
reviewList.author: Viet Cao

reviewList.text: This was the best massage we’ve ever had. We came for a full body massage in the evening and enjoyed it so much that we came back the next morning for face and shoulders. Great experience! The staff are very friendly, the place is clean, and the price is good as well. Highly recommended.
reviewList.author: Emilia Krasucka

reviewList.text:
I had an amazing experience at this spa and would highly recommend it! One thing I really appreciated is how easy it is to book—appointments can be made directly through their website, and all the prices are clearly listed, which makes everything very transparent and convenient.

I booked the 24-step hair spa, and it was absolutely worth it. The treatment lasted around 90 minutes and included so much more than just hair care—it felt like a full pampering session. I had an arm massage, facial, leg massage, and of course the full hair treatment with mask and serum. Every step felt thoughtful and well-executed.

The whole experience was incredibly relaxing, and you can tell they pay attention to detail. I left feeling refreshed, pampered, and very happy with the results.

Definitely a great place to treat yourself!
reviewList.author: Gabriela

reviewList.text: We had a wonderful family time at Babylon Spa! We decided to get the hair spa (relax shampoo) treatment and it was incredible. The staff showed great hospitality from the moment we walked in, making my whole family feel welcome and pampered. Great service, professional therapists, and a beautiful, clean atmosphere. We will definitely come back next time we are in Da Nang!
reviewList.author: Devesh Prasad

places.name: Luxury Healthy Spa & Massage
places.address: 224 Trần Bạch Đằng, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: So so at best. My masseuse started super strong (for aromatherapy massage) like she wanted to put one of her knuckles through the sole of my foot. She adjusted after a quick discussion, though, which I appreciated. The rest of the massage was not relaxing, more someone new to the profession trying to do what they were taught - by no means an expert.  It was fine until she did the thing where the masseuse pulls your toes or your fingers - and both times I thought she was going to pull a digit off!  She tried, and was nice so three stars, but I wouldnt go back. Two other not amazing things - they try a hard upsell when you’re choosing a massage - first encouraging 4 hand massage and then, if you choose a 60 minute massage, pushing for 90. Not the absolute end of the world, but not of this made the massage relaxing.  That said the front desk staff were extremely sweet and likable.
reviewList.author: soupergrover

reviewList.text:
I’m from Germany, went to many places in Danang and mostly I was fine. This place was horrible - from the moment I entered the Spa, there was no welcoming, no one cared. Many random people walked in and out and talked super loud at the lobby, I was not get paid attention for 5min. Then, they asked me to sit down - no tea or warm welcome just “what massage do you want”. I was already annoyed but gave it a shot since so many reviews were positive. I took 90min massage aroma. I asked the front desk why it’s so loud, because even the people behind the front desk were shouting to another stuff at the entrance about things. I asked if it shouldn’t be relaxing and at least the staff should try to be quiet. She just smiled and continued with my booking. The massage itself was ok, nothing special. However, the therapist had middle long nails so it scratched me a lot. Also she seemed to have a flu as she was sniffling with her nose all the time. Afterwards she asked me for a tip which I gave her unwillingly. I left the spa without any beverage, tea or snack.

The service was very disappointing and many “guests” came in and out like it was a Basar.

Paid in the end with tip 700.000 dong - safe your money and go somewhere else where people get greeted, service is welcoming and ambience is quite and chill.
reviewList.author: Fil

reviewList.text: Lovely experience. VIP kind of service. They sent a van to pick us up at our hotel. Welcomed us with black bean tea and we had our 90-min healthy massage. Fave during massage were the hot stone and heat packs on the belly, eye and neck. Great experience! I’d bring my parents here when I get the change to bring them here for vacation.
reviewList.author: Anya Catherine

reviewList.text: I finally found my place for a foot massage. Its the first in Vietnam doing it the right way. With pressure and precision! 10/10 to that guy! Duy 25 was my Masseuse and Tuyen was a wonderful woman giving me the right treatment options.
reviewList.author: RealReviews

reviewList.text:
Extremely disappointing experience from start to finish. The staff had very limited English and struggled to understand even basic instructions, which made communication frustrating throughout the visit.

I booked a body massage and a head massage expecting a relaxing experience, but unfortunately, it was far from it. The service felt rushed, and there was little attention to customer comfort or satisfaction. The biggest issue came after the massage when they blow-dried my hair. Instead of handling it with care, they left my hair completely tangled and knotted, causing unnecessary discomfort and forcing me to spend a long time fixing it afterward.

Another major concern was the excessive heat used during the treatment. The heat was not properly controlled, and my scalp became painful from the high temperature. It wasn’t limited to my scalp either—they also applied heat to my face and shoulders, which was uncomfortable and concerning.

For a place that offers spa and wellness services, I expected professionalism, attention to detail, and basic customer care, but none of these expectations were met. A spa visit should leave you feeling refreshed and relaxed, not frustrated, uncomfortable, and disappointed.

I would not recommend this place to anyone. This is not about saving money—it’s about avoiding poor service and an unpleasant experience. There are many better options available. Save yourself the time, money, and frustration, and choose another spa.
reviewList.author: Sharmila Mekala

reviewList.text: The staff are friendly and the pick-up service is a great feature. They also allow you to have a quick shower before the massage which is a plus. However, the massage itself is definitely over-hyped. I asked for focus on my legs and feet but they put immense force on cracking my back and shoulders and proceeded to just caress my legs and feet. If you’ve had massages done by professionals before, you’ll know right away that there was little skill involved here. Me and my husband left unsatisfied.
reviewList.author: Yoon-Ah Kim

reviewList.text: We visited Pink Spa and were completely delighted! We took a massage with aroma oils - it was a real relaxation for the body and soul. Very cozy atmosphere, pleasant music, polite and attentive staff. Massage therapists work professionally, you can feel the experience and care for the client. Aroma oils are perfectly selected, after the procedure you feel lightness, calmness and complete relaxation. Thank you Pink Spa for a wonderful holiday and quality service! We will definitely come back again and recommend you to our friends.
reviewList.author: Lilla

reviewList.text:
Had such an amazing experience at the spa! So good. Clean, professional staff & very cooperative.
The ambience is just amazing!
reviewList.author: Shasank Leera

reviewList.text: I had a wonderful experience at Pink Spa! The pickup service was so convenient, and even though there were 8 of us, they kindly accepted our reservation the day before. The staff were very friendly, and it was especially comfortable because there was a Korean staff member who made communication easy. The massage itself was amazing so good that I went back for another session before returning to Korea. Highly recommended👍👍👍
reviewList.author: 민지

reviewList.text: My wife and I had Full Body massage in Pink Spa. From start to finish it was really great experience and amazing massage. The level of pressure was perfect and the massage was excellent. We will recommend Pink Spa to everyone. We loved it so much that we booked another 90 minutes each on the same day and coming back later in the evening. Thank you 🙏
reviewList.author: Jim D

reviewList.text: It was one of the nicest experience I've ever had! My lovely masseuse was such a professional, the Spa personnel was very warm and welcoming 😊🙏 they even treated me a coconut pudding dessert once after the treatment, and tea with cookies twice: before and after. I will definitely come back, thank you 🩷🌸
reviewList.author: Nia Nova

reviewList.text: Very professional. Service is top-notched. The therapists are great with what they do. Reception is very accomodating. The overall interior and ambiance of the spa is relaxing and pleasing to the eyes. It's clean and smells good. Worth the price you pay. Will totally recommend
reviewList.author: iriisxix

reviewList.text: I go for massages whenever I travel around Southeast Asia, and this place offers one of the best I've tried. Their service is impeccable. Drinks and a snack are served before the massage, and the same are served with dessert after. The massage itself is customised according to how you like it, with a simple and concise drawing for you to mark out areas of focus before the massage begins. Make an appointment so that you won't be disappointed. A 6-star rating if I could give one!
reviewList.author: Michael Teo

reviewList.text:
After much research and reading reviews of many spas, I finally decided on Queen Spa.

It was a really excellent experience. The front staff welcomed me very sincerely and made me feel immediately comfortable. The attention to detail and in making sure I
understood the process of the massage that I choose( bamboo) really let me know that I was in good and attentive hands.

The therapist (Molly?) had good energy and paid attention to my cues and adjusted accordingly.

I look forward to trying out another modality here. It’s not the cheapest massage in Danang, but as the adage goes: You get what you pay for. In this case it was true, in the most positive way:)
reviewList.author: maliesha pullano

reviewList.text: First time visit here, the staffs are super friendly and helpful. The massage service is amazing. The place is super clean and relax. Instructions are very clear, no hidden fee. Feeling happy, DaNang must try.
reviewList.author: Arska Salov

reviewList.text: It was not easy to find a good massage place in da nang for me. It’s either cleanliness or consistency etc. I was lucky to find one- Charm. The therapist is super skilful and the environment was clean. Yes it’s slightly pricey compared to others but I think it’s worth the price. Keep it up
reviewList.author: Sean Yap

reviewList.text: This is indeed a beautiful find in Danang, the place is beautifully done up. We walked in for a massage and walked out totally relaxed. Love that, after massage they give you a place to have some dessert. Bought a package and use it every other day. So worth it. They will have you note on a paper which are the areas needing their attention more or less. It was cold one day we went and they had the hot fan on. Lovely ....
reviewList.author: Dre E

reviewList.text: excellent service with amazing price. the staffs were very friendly and professional! we did a package with hair wash with facial massage and neck/back/shoulder massage. It was super comfortable and we enjoyed every process. Our skin felt really glowing and my hair turned out smooth and silky after the service.
reviewList.author: Prim Pantha

reviewList.text:
Very expensive - 600k/hr and 900k/90' .
The facility does not look , shared room.
The technician was very average , didn't use force to the massage despite multiple request....
The facial spa used cheap brands (I could smell it) although they said using Dermalogica products (I could feel they only used the daily micro exfoliant product , while cleanser / mask.... were of cheap brands!) .
reviewList.author: Duong Maggie

reviewList.text: This place was great! Purchased the bamboo massage because I had never heard of or had that before. My gf purchased the Vietnamese traditional massage and both of us were very pleased. Both were hour long sessions. The bamboo massage was extremely relaxing and I’d definitely recommend it to anyone. As a construction worker back home my body takes a beating, but I felt like a new person walking out of here. I’d come here again and recommend this place to anyone. Cheers from San Francisco.
reviewList.author: Will Jimenez

places.name: Julius Spa & Massage
places.address: B4 14, An Thượng 38, Ngũ Hành Sơn

reviewList.text: 10 out of 10 experience! Welcome tea and mango, then the massage itself was amazing. Feel like I was reborn. :-) then after the massage one gets treated with a tea and some local coconut cracker as well as I was given  some coconut gift as well. A very rare hidden gem. Atmosphere and staff are very friendly and very welcoming. Will definitely come back. Thank you 🙏🏼
reviewList.author: Roland Danyi

reviewList.text: Been here a couple of times during my stay and always had a great experience. The massage and hair wash were both amazing, and the staff are so welcoming and friendly. I also love the little touches — mango and pandan tea when you arrive, then coconut biscuits and tea before you leave. Such a peaceful and relaxing atmosphere 😌
reviewList.author: Sara L

reviewList.text: My husband and I went here together. I did the 60 min hot stone massage + 30 min shampoo and he did the thai massage. The massages were very good with the right amount of pressure and friendly staff that checked in to make sure we were enjoying it throughout. This was my first shampoo experience, so I did not know what to expect. It was very enjoyable but a new hair brush that was not previously used would have been preferred. The staff asked me to leave this review with a picture before leaving, which I did not appreciate, although overall still a good experience.
reviewList.author: Kelsea Mitropoulos

reviewList.text: Amazing experience! The staff were incredibly kind, attentive and professional. They made sure I was comfortable throughout the entire massage and paid attention to every detail. The atmosphere was relaxing and the massage itself was exactly what I needed after a long journey. I left feeling completely refreshed. Highly recommended!
reviewList.author: Edgar Rahhimov

reviewList.text: An amazing time was had here at Julius Spa & Massage (1). Clean and probably the best service you’ll find around for this price point.
reviewList.author: Camden Smith

places.name: Panda Spa Body & Foot Massage Danang
places.address: Panda Spa, 229 Nguyễn Văn Thoại, An Hải

reviewList.text:
If you’re looking for a massage in Da Nang, do yourself a favor and come to Panda Spa Body & Foot Massage Danang! We came as a group of 8 and paid a total of about 4,000,000 VND (around $60 USD per person, including tip), and it was honestly one of the best values of our trip.

We booked the foot massage, but it was so much more than just your feet! It included an amazing head, neck, shoulder, and leg massage too. We all walked out feeling completely refreshed after a long day of exploring. The therapists were skilled, the atmosphere was relaxing, and everyone in our group loved it.

They also served tea and snacks before and after the massage, which was such a thoughtful touch and made the whole experience feel even more welcoming.

For the quality, service, and price, this place is absolutely worth visiting. If you’re in Da Nang, don’t skip this place—we’d all come back in a heartbeat!
reviewList.author: Jiliza Naval

reviewList.text: 10/10 experience! From the moment we walked in, everything was amazing. We were welcomed with warm tea, followed by the massage of our choice. After our treatment, we were taken to a separate relaxation room where we enjoyed fresh fruit and snacks. The entire experience was relaxing, thoughtful, and beautifully done. We will definitely be coming back again and again! 😊
reviewList.author: Fatu Halloran

reviewList.text:
This spa is in a super convenient location near Nguyen Van Thoai beach road, very easy to walk to when traveling in Da Nang. The shop itself is beautiful and eye-catching, creating a very relaxing atmosphere from the moment you walk in.

The staff were all incredibly warm, attentive, and professional. The massage was absolutely amazing — so relaxing and comfortable that I felt completely refreshed afterward. The receptionists were also very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better.

At the end of the massage, they even served delicious creamy flan cake and bananas, such a sweet and thoughtful touch 🥹

Highly recommend this spa to anyone visiting Da Nang. Definitely a place worth experiencing!
reviewList.author: CHI DINH NHAT

reviewList.text:
I stay nearby and just chose the nearest massage salon I saw, and what a great choice it was! Though prices are not the lowest, they are reasonable and fair. I had 60min aroma massage and it was very good, they have a lovely silk-like sets to wear during massage which is something new for me. Before massage, I also had a cinnamon foot bath, this was nice :)
starting from the minute I came in I was surrounded by care, everyone is extremely polite and attentive. Probably it should not be surprising in the customer service, but in Vietnam I do not see everyone to be extremely friendly so it is something I noticed.

If I stayed longer, I would definitely come back, so highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Antonina Vezhnevets

reviewList.text: Good. I arrived a little late, but the staff were still very enthusiastic. I used the 90 mins body massage package and was truly impressed with the technicians. They did a great job on all the areas that hurt me. You should specify your pain points to the receptionist so they can remind you; that would be even better. Awesome! I will definitely come back next time to relax again
reviewList.author: Authen Catizen

reviewList.text: I saw the Crayon Shin-chan figure at the entrance, and suddenly felt sympathy and familiarity, and received the full course that can be received at the barber shop. I really liked it. And the kindness. I recommend it..
reviewList.author: B.S. David Kim

reviewList.text: I think I was approached by the Korean owner lady when I walk in for nail inquiry.  Nice simply place.  Location is facing the river.  Staffs are super friendly.  Price is reasonable too.
reviewList.author: Amanda O

reviewList.text: Massage was excellent and location was very convenient. The view spa located near Han Market and the River, nice place to get relaxed after market shopping. They also provide pick up and sanding service.
reviewList.author: R Lee

reviewList.text: Clean and central, reasonable and very good massage! We visited on a cruise and stopped to be pampered! They added a 10% tip which was very fair. Highly recommend!
reviewList.author: Barbara Kent

reviewList.text: Considerably satisfying process and facilities. My family and I were satisfied with the conditon of bed and room. Quite friendly staff in general. Highly skillful as well. Worth the money I spent!
reviewList.author: 김지효 (zisooni)

reviewList.text: This place was lovely!!! They did an amazing job on my nails but also made me so comfortable with beverage, snack, hot towels and pillows. The technicians were determined to make me happy and went above and beyond! If you are in Da Nang this is the best place to get your nails done !!!
reviewList.author: Rachel Fleming

reviewList.text: Overall great experience at this spa! Very friendly employees and calm environment. Worth coming here, my pedicure looks so nice!
reviewList.author: Sophia Stenzel

reviewList.text: Lovely girls and amazing nail service. Really good prices too. Shop is located right next to the waterfront. 10/10 recommend for anyone who needs nails or massage services!
reviewList.author: Georgia Goodman

reviewList.text:
Price is very affordable, and the experience generally matches what you pay for.
I did the 45-minute hair wash package. The facial mask included was fine but nothing special. After removing the mask, there was no moisturizer or follow-up product to seal in hydration, so my skin actually felt drier afterward, which made that part feel a bit pointless.

The hair wash itself was okay, but I didn’t notice anything special about the “curve waterfall” water feature. Hair drying was poorly done — it was basically a quick blow-dry and my hair was still wet, to the point that I had to ask for a hair dryer and finish it myself.

Overall, it’s acceptable for the price, but nothing stood out, and I wouldn’t return.
reviewList.author: Jenny Ongkamongkol

reviewList.text: The host in the front is straight to the point. Massage was basic, however the two people doing our massage didn’t know I understand Vietnamese and was talking negatively about us (while smiling at us) the entire time starting with the foot soak. Making it hard to relax & trust knowing there are rude comments about us. Lots of places to choose from in this area. Do not recommend.
reviewList.author: Anna

places.name: BEAUTY SALON LỘC
places.address: 65 Trưng Nữ Vương, Phường, Hải Châu

reviewList.text:
Please don’t come here.

I chose Salon Loc after doing quite a bit of research because they had strong reviews on both Google and Reddit. I went in wanting a C-curl and volume perm to fix two main issues: flatness and frizz. I even prepared a full Pinterest board of reference photos and used ChatGPT to translate exactly what I wanted and what my concerns were.

The service was not cheap — I paid around USD 120. On top of that, they pushed me to add a keratin treatment. I later learned that combining a keratin treatment with a fresh perm is generally not recommended, which already made me question the salon’s understanding of hair health and treatment compatibility.

The experience itself also felt disorganized. The manager who initially consulted me disappeared midway through the appointment and handed me over to someone else without much explanation. The handling throughout was quite rough, and I went through around five separate washes. They also mentioned a haircut and massage as part of the service — the massage was relaxing enough, but it was just a standard shoulder massage and not really anything notable.

What concerned me most was the actual perming process. I kept trying to trust the process, but several things felt off, including them using a hair straightener on my hair while product was still applied.

Unfortunately, the final result speaks for itself. The “volume perm” sections are visibly sticking out in awkward bends, while the C-curl I originally wanted is basically nonexistent. The stylist recommended going for a softer wave instead, but the end result just looks like poorly rebonded hair with random bends underneath. My hair also feels significantly more damaged now, especially near the roots, and salons back home have already told me the damage makes it difficult to safely fix or salvage.

The massage helped release a lot of tension in my body, and the facial was amazing. They use natural ingredients which left my skin feeling fresh, calm, and glowing afterwards.
What I really appreciated was the attention to detail and the warm, welcoming atmosphere. You can really tell that they care about their customers' experience.
If you are visiting Da Nang and looking for a quality spa with great service and relaxing treatments, I highly recommend Rosie Spa. I will definitely come back again on my next trip!

reviewList.text:
Let me start by saying I was originally going to leave 1 star. When I first came in (after lots of research and reading reviews) I decided to get a shampoo and facial. Unfortunately, my masseuse at that time was not very good. I had asked for fingertips, but got nails. I constantly had to ask for more pressure, even using translation app multiple times, but it was always lacking. She also got shampoo inside my ear drums and on my eyes.

Anyways, when I had told the front desk of my experience, I was given a 20% discount, along with a voucher for a free service of any kind (this was unexpected).

I went back the next day for a deep tissue massage, and I was very relaxed - almost fell asleep! I forgot to get her name, but she was very good. I have lots of knots and whenever it felt like things were starting to get too much, she instinctively swapped to other parts of the body without me ever having to mention anything.

I think as long as you ask for someone with experience and a good track record, you'll enjoy your experience here :)

He listened perfectly to my request for long layers that frame my face without losing length, and he gave expert advice on products for my fine, Asian hair that tends to frizz in Texas humidity. reviewList.author: 何楷蘅

reviewList.text:
I honestly don’t understand the high rating of this spa.

I’ve visited many spas in Da Nang, including budget-friendly ones, and most of them provided a much better experience than Bana Spa. The place looks good online and in photos, but the actual service was disappointing.

The restroom was poorly maintained and did not match the image the spa tries to present. During the hair washing service, the staff seemed rushed and unwilling to properly dry my hair. They even accidentally scratched my face, which was uncomfortable and unprofessional.

What shocked me the most was that after the service, I was given a bottle of water that appeared to have already been opened and partially consumed by someone else. This is completely unacceptable from a hygiene and customer service standpoint.

Another concern was that after the treatment, we were encouraged to leave a Google review in exchange for a 20% refund. This made me question how genuine some of the reviews are.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but I don’t want other tourists to spend their money here based on potentially misleading ratings. There are many better spas in Da Nang that offer better service, better hygiene, and a much better overall experience for the same price or less.

reviewList.text:

reviewList.text: I loved it sm, the staff would accommodate you whether the pressure or what they do is okay. Hygiene wise it's good too. My hair turned out so soft and it smells so good. I also loved the back and facial massages. Worth the money!

reviewList.text:
I’m very disappointed with my experience here.

I came specifically for a head spa / hair treatment and was promised a certain type of service, which was not delivered at all. Instead of relaxation, the treatment damaged my hair. The staff clearly did not know how to handle curly hair, and I left with my hair tangled, dry, and in worse condition than when I arrived.

After the treatment, I had to fix my hair myself — detangle it, apply conditioner, and repair the damage — which completely defeats the purpose of coming for a professional service.

What made the experience even worse was the attitude at the reception. There was no apology, no empathy, and no attempt to help or take responsibility. I felt dismissed and unheard.

This place may work for straight hair, but if you have curls or expect the service that is promised, I would not recommend it.
reviewList.author: לירי עטיה

reviewList.text: Upon entering, I immediately felt the tranquility and the incredibly pleasant aroma of essential oils. The space here is designed very subtly, creating a feeling of maximum privacy, unlike other noisy massage establishments. The staff were welcoming, making me feel comfortable from the very first moment. An ideal place to recharge after stressful days at work.
reviewList.author: Kiều Ngọc

places.name: Nhà mình spa Gội Đầu Dưỡng Sinh Massage Body

reviewList.author: Dương Hà Phương

reviewList.text:
I LOVE IT! This place has a 5.0 average review for all the great reasons.
Prompt, pleasant, and professional.
Call to reserve to help them plan if you can, but if you just turn up like we did, they're awesome at magically making it work 👌

We, a group of 4 (females), went in 8:30pm, an hour before close. There were only 2 workers there both occupied. One promptly helped us address all our questions while  finishing up with their clients and sat us down for tea.

Our interactions were super pleasant. We used Google translate and body language to sort every thing out. No confusion on what was included in the menu or pricing. (Cash only though, worth noting.)

Within like 5 mins, all her reinforcements showed up to make sure we all get out of there before 10pm. I got the full body massage. It was thorough and professional. Just the right pressure, and communication. The stone massage was really unique. The hair wash/massage my friends got were also great.

I'd go again if I wasn't leaving the area tomorrow early morning. Don't miss this gem ❤️

(Bonus, the workers there are all super cute! 😎)
reviewList.author: Vivian C

reviewList.text:
I don’t usually get massages but coming from a long trip from Japan I felt I needed one. Friends didn’t have any recommendations.
So I googled whatever is near my hotel and found Nha Minh. Based on the positive reviews, I decided to come.

The rave reviews were spot on. The place was clean, relaxing and my masseuse provided friendly, effective massage. I had the one-hour (I had a meeting to go to afterwards) hot stone package. My exhausted body was restored. This was amazing great value. I loved the service so much I plan to return, as early as next week.

I have to mention Ms. Vuong, manager/owner. When I called to make a reservation, she squeezed me in at a busy time, 5pm. On my way, she followed up to make sure I found the place alright. I was 20 feet from the door and she was there waiting for me. She explained the different offerings, in very clear English. She guided me through what turned out to be the right choice for me. And as I was leaving, she saw me off at the door. Talk about deluxe customer service. This operator genuinely cares for her customers.

Lastly, a reviewer complained about temperature. It was not cold, as claimed. Not even close. Not hot either. They keep the temperature at just the right comfortable level.

Another said staff were talking all the time and it was a noisy environment. Staff talked to each other, yes, but they whispered, and said very little, like 1-2 sentences every 3 minutes or so. The place was pretty much dead quiet. All you can hear is this soft, relaxing piano lounge music. Oh and the sighs of happy customers (one reviewer said she moaned lol).

Then someone said the massage hurt? Of course it might. But you only have to tell your masseuse.  At one point I felt a bit of discomfort but I told my masseuse and immediately she adjusted her technique and pressure and it was alright after that.

This place deserves 6 stars if you ask me. I know I’ll be a regular customer.

reviewList.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ A Wonderful, Professional Couple’s Spa Experience

During our vacation in Da Nang, my wife and I were looking for a relaxing spa day together, and Lounge Spa Danang exceeded our expectations.

The spa has created a welcoming, comfortable, and peaceful atmosphere from the moment you walk through the door. Everyone we interacted with was friendly, professional, and attentive, making us feel completely at ease.

My wife enjoyed a gel manicure and pedicure, a 60-minute foot massage, and a neck and shoulder massage. She left feeling completely refreshed and very happy with the results.

I chose their 90-minute Barbershop Combo, which included a traditional shave with facial massage, eyebrow and nose trimming, fingernail care, ear cleaning, hair wash and blow dry, plus massages for my back, legs, feet, neck, shoulders, and scalp. It was one of the most relaxing grooming experiences I’ve ever had, and the staff never made the service feel rushed.

One thing I’d especially like to mention for fellow international travelers: this is a professional wellness spa offering genuine massage and grooming services. If you’re simply looking for a relaxing, therapeutic spa experience (as we were), you can feel completely comfortable here. There were no awkward moments or uncomfortable upselling—just skilled, professional staff focused on helping us unwind.

The value was outstanding. Including tip, we paid a total of 1,540,000 VND (about US$58.56 / NZ$103.82) for everything:

* My Barbershop Combo: 460,000 VND (about US$17.49 / NZ$32.01)
* My wife’s services: 900,000 VND (about US$34.22 / NZ$60.67)

Considering the quality of the treatments and the amount of time we spent there, we thought the prices were exceptionally reasonable.

One thing to keep in mind: they currently accept cash only, so plan accordingly.

If you’re visiting Da Nang and want a legitimate, relaxing spa experience with excellent service and great value, we highly recommend Lounge Spa Danang. We wouldn’t hesitate to return on our next visit.

Hello...
I came to Da Nang not for sightseeing or travel, but for a pure vacation to relieve stress and recover my lost physical strength.
As a researcher at Samsung, I have a project in progress, so I have no choice but to spend half of my vacation in the morning and take care of work at the hotel.

I considered Japan, but since it has the same climate as Korea, I chose a warm place, and I spend my days going back and forth between restaurants, coffee shops, spas, and hotels.
I also chose a quiet hotel to avoid places with too many people, and I used the hotel spa three times, but the only thing that set it apart was the facilities, and in terms of price, it was not cost-effective at all.
I usually use my laptop for long periods of time, so I prefer spas over alcohol due to turtle neck and shoulder pain.
I use a large spa and many spas once a day, and I found a spa that I often visit, which is the lounge spa that I am introducing to you. The CEO is Korean and has worked for a large company for 20 years and has established himself in Da Nang.
First of all, he is kind and provides pick-up and sanding services, and the facilities are clean, and the employees' work attitude is excellent and kind.
And there are Korean-speaking employees on site, so there is no inconvenience..
I also recommend this spa because it is near the hotel I am staying at, and I have been using it frequently since I happened to stop by.

You will receive more discounts when you visit again.

I highly recommend it.
Thank you.

Even with a language barrier, it was very easy to communicate with the staff about what we wanted, and they were very attentive to our needs.

reviewList.text:
Didn’t realise this spa was so close to M Hotel. Went in today for a foot massage. Really pretty and spacious place. Also very clean. Was brought some a drink upon entry. I was also given a choice of oils to use for the massage and could test smell them first. Lemongrass was very refreshing.

There are lockers to keep your belongings inside while you have massage -  very handy.
They have very cute looking footbowls to wash the feet. After washing the feet, was led to a spacious room with large chairs in a circle for the foot massage. My masseuse was very good as I had requested for strong massage. They gave some heated bags for the shoulders while kneading the legs.

After the massage was over, was given a drink and some yoghurt with mango.

It’s cash only at this place.

Would recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Sue Sieper

reviewList.text:
I live in the Ngũ Hành Sơn neighborhood of Da Nang and have been curious about AME Spa & Wellness since they took over the old AMI Chocolate Coffee space. Today was their soft opening, and I was lucky enough to be one of the very first customers—second in line for a 90‑minute foot massage.

My therapist, Hiep, had wonderfully gentle hands and a soothing rhythm that melted away the fatigue in my feet. The experience began with a refreshing foot shampoo in a designated area, which set the tone perfectly. Afterwards, I was led to a large, soft, and very comfortable chair where I chose lavender oil—absolutely delightful. Honestly, I wished the 90 minutes could have stretched into hours.

The soft opening promotion was a great deal: 50% off, so I only paid 325,000 VND instead of 650,000 VND. On top of that, I was offered a mysterious blue drink (tasted surprisingly good!) and a mango yogurt that was excellent.

The spa itself is clean, has a calming ambiance, and feels very professional. I’ll definitely be coming back regularly, and I highly recommend AME Spa & Wellness to anyone who appreciates a relaxing environment and skilled massage. Next time, I’m excited to try their body massage, facial, or even ear cleaning service.
reviewList.author: Patrick Kong

reviewList.text: A fantastic experience in AME Spa and Wellness from the time you walk in the door to the time you walk out. The massage was undoubtedly the best I have had, very relaxing and then onto the hair shampoo and head massage. The girls know how to give you the full treatment which I welcomed after a very busy day. Thank you so much, I highly recommend your new business. 🏆🏆

reviewList.text: I went sightseeing all day so my feet were tired, so I went for a 90-minute foot massage. The staff pressed the acupuncture points, asked me how I felt while doing it, and after that my feet felt light as if they were empty.

reviewList.text: I feel bad that I have to leave this review, but health risk is not something that I take lightly. My husband and I came here for foot massages one night. The staff were very friendly and welcomed us with water as we soaked our feet. We didn't drink the water as the gentleman who had served the water had a very phlegmy cough and seemed sick. After a short while we were taken to the back and got our foot/leg massages. My husband said his was good, mine was just okay. My masseuse completely forgot to massage one of my calves and the towels they wiped us down with smelled heavily of mildew, but in the end we still appreciated their hard work and tipped them nicely. A couple days later, we noticed dark red spots on my husband's shins which ended up being the start of a skin infection. We don't know if it's fungal or bacterial, but we are treating it with medication for both and it is finally starting to clear up after a couple of frustrating weeks.

reviewList.text: While waiting for night flight, had a lovely foot massage with my cousin. 2 ladies did a wonderful job and all the stress has gone for both of us. Very kind and friendly staff, will visit again if we visit Da Nang.
