Visited with my partner, who is a local, and was surprised to find we were given different menus. Foreigners are charged higher prices, even when accompanied by or married to a local. I found this policy unfair and disappointing.

The massage itself was also below expectations. The session appeared to finish before the advertised time, and the therapist seemed uninterested throughout. There was no greeting, no friendly interaction, and no thank you at the end.

Poor service and unfair pricing. I would not recommend this place.
reviewList.author: Chuan Lik Ng

reviewList.text:
A lot of the reviews for this place are reviewers with only 1 or 2 reviews leading me to believe they’re fake.

It’s cheap, but you get what you pay for. It started out with a foot soak, where we pretty much had to stand in a little bowl of water. They were expecting us to sit on the massage tables but they were too high up so we were leaning against them. The shampoo I got smelled like chemicals and I could barely breathe. My masseuse did her job like she was upset at me. Like she came home after a long day of work and saw a sink full of dirty dishes she had to do as quickly as possible. I began to dread the massage that was next. To my surprise, the massage was slightly better than the shampoo. However, we asked (and paid for) an “aroma massage” but we only got a foot massage. My fiancé was left on the shampoo table and had to rest her head on the hard sink during her massage. At least I got a pillow. We left feeling sad and defeated. We usually tip at least 200.000 dong each to reward for their hard work and for the first time we left 50.000 each. Almost wanted to not tip at all.
reviewList.author: Xander

reviewList.text: Did a 90 mins aroma massage, very professional service. It cured my neck and back pains. Definitely will come back
reviewList.author: ETH W

reviewList.text:
I would like to share some professional feedback regarding my recent experience. I hope the owner can take this seriously and improve the service quality and overall environment for customers.

Firstly, I strongly suggest providing masks for staff to wear while serving customers. During hair washing and body massage services, the staff’s breath blowing directly onto customers’ faces is very uncomfortable. In addition, one staff member appeared to have a flu, cough, and runny nose while serving customers, and unfortunateIly i became sick afterwards as well. For hygiene and customer comfort, staff who are unwell should rest at home or all staffs wear masks while working or consultaion

Secondly, the ventilation and air-conditioning conditions need improvement. The fan was not functioning properly and was blowing directly onto my face, which felt unpleasant. However, when the fan was turned off, the hair washing room became extremely hot because the air conditioner was not working. It would be good for the owner to repair the air conditioner as soon as possible to provide a more comfortable environment for customers.

The hair wash area is quite messy, I also feel the cleanliness and organization of the shop should be improved. Towels were placed on the bedside table without proper arrangement, making it unclear whether they were for hair washing, body massage, hand massage, or foot massage. This creates an unhygienic impression.

In addition, the customer toilet was also being used as a shower area, and the floor inside toilet was constantly wet. This did not feel comfortable or private for customers. I would suggest having a separate shower/toilet area for family use and a separate toilet for customers to maintain professionalism and hygiene standards.

Another important point is the shop’s professional image. There is no proper reception counter, and family members were lying on the leg massage chairs near the main entrance during working hours. Customers can immediately see this when opening the main door, and it gives an unprofessional impression. It would be more appropriate for owners and staff to sit properly at a reception counter during business hours. If anyone wishes to rest, it would be better to do so inside a private room where customers cannot see.

Lastly, there was no drinking water offered to customers before or after the services. This small gesture is part of basic customer hospitality and professionalism.

I hope the owner can consider these suggestions seriously to improve customer experience and maintain better professional standards for the business.

P/s:

I purchased the Intensive Hair Wash service _ duration of 60 minutes.
I noted that face massage was not included, so I requested for face massage.
The staff informed me that there would be an additional charge of 25,000 VND.

I then asked how long the face massage would be. One staff member seemed ready to answer honestly, but another staff member stopped her and quickly replied that it would be 10 minutes.

Based on this information, the total service duration should have been 70 minutes (60 minutes hair wash + 10 minutes face massage). However, the overall service time was still only 60 minutes in total.

I hope the owner can clarify the service timing and ensure transparency with customers regarding additional services and duration. Professional communication and honesty are very important for customer trust and satisfaction.

📌The woman owner *kept pushing additional services* to my mother even after we clearly declined. We had to say “no” many times, which made us feel uncomfortable.

I understand recommending services is part of business, but customers’ decisions should be respected without repeated pressure.

P/s: khi khách nằm xuống là kim dài chỉ số 2,  nhân viên chạm vào mặt là kim dài nhích qua số 2 ít.
Khi nhân viên bảo khách xong rồi ngồi dậy, kim dài chỉ số 2 nhít qua chút. Như vậy là 60 phút hay 70 phút? cộng sấy tóc, mặc quần áo, nói chuyện với nhau rồi bước ra ngoài : cũng 15 phút

reviewList.text:
I got an incredibly good massage by Huyen; I just asked for a foot massage, 1h, but I didn’t know I’ll get so much. Ask for Huyen and you won’t be disappointed.

Really really good therapist (Huyen), adapting very sensitively to any request of intensity or technique;

Hot stones, foot scrub, short head massage at the end upon request etc etc. also she was never on her phone, which I did appreciate a lot! I hate when that happens and I never come a second time because of it.

What to improve:

1. Put the phone on 100% silent, no notifications or vibrations should be heard during the massage, at all.

2. Ideally nobody should enter the room during the massage. If this cat be avoided, the person entering should be really light on the door, really silent, fast to exit; don’t enter like a hurricane, waking up the client who was already napping 😅😉

Thank you, will come again 😘

I joined a group tour and paid separately for a Vietnamese hair wash. The price was expensive, the experience was extremely poor!

The staff member was clearly a beginner—very slow and unprofessional. The massage was weak, so I asked her to apply more pressure. She did, but she was massaging completely wrong. She then rushed through the head and neck portions carelessly.

Unable to tolerate it any longer, I requested a different staff member midway through, which was much better. However, I wasted ten minutes waiting for the switch, and including the earlier time lost, over half an hour was wasted with no compensation provided.

The quality control is extremely poor. Didn’t the shop test her skills beforehand? If they did and this was the acceptable standard, I believe this establishment is simply a scam.

reviewList.text:
Please do yourself a favor and find another spa. I never leave bad reviews, but I really want to make sure people don’t have the experience we just had.

My sister, mom, and I came in for a massage. They took us into a back room that was quite hot and humid. They then came in to give us the massage, but they were clearly upset about something and started speaking very loudly and shaking their fists at each other. This went on for about a minute and then they told us to lie down.

During the massages, the lady doing me coughed directly onto me. The lady doing my sister was constantly coughing and burping. The lady doing my mom left multiple times for long periods. The massages themselves were adequate at best, but the overall experience was terrible.

When they were done, they left to give us time to change. They then came back in VERY quickly while my sister was still undressed and began demanding a tip. We were confused and thought maybe they wanted us to pay for the massages, but no - they stood there and loudly told us “TIP ME” until we handed over a tip. We would still have tipped, despite the bad experience, but this loud demanding was extremely unprofessional and stressful. My sister literally hadn’t even finished changing yet.

We then watched them remake the massage beds with exactly the same sheets and blankets they had just used on us. Gross?

Would not recommend.
reviewList.author: Brionna Wheaton

reviewList.text: Biggest regret for doing my nails here, turned out to be very average and ugly.  The worst part was the owner didn't honor the price and tried to raise price.  When I insisted to pay only the price she mentioned early, the owner gave me annoyed face and rolled her eyes.  Save yourself from attitudes and spend money else where for better.

reviewList.text: I went here twice with some friends, once for a foot massage and another time for a neck and shoulder massage. Both times, there was nothing much wrong with the massages themselves. However, the first time my masseuse got up and left many times assumedly to attend to other potential customers. The second time, the massage was more rushed, my masseuse was coughing quite a lot and burped several times. At the end, she said “tip me!” many times despite the outdoor sign saying “No Tip”. reviewList.text:
1★ – A serious mistake!

I saw this place advertised on Facebook and decided to give it a try. It turned out to be a mistake — a serious one.

If you are looking for a place to unwind, DO NOT COME HERE. Instead of relaxing music, you are exposed to doors slamming, people loudly choosing services, and hairdryers roaring upstairs. Rather than calming down, your anxiety builds up and you end up more tense than when you arrived.

The headpiece keeps screeching, and the poorly installed curtain allows harsh light to shine directly into your face, which was extremely annoying. Hygiene standards are shockingly low: towels are rinsed in the same bowl where your hair is washed, and the same towels are used to wipe the body and then the face. “All in one,” apparently. The towel used to dry my hair SMELLED OF MOLD, and I had to remove it immediately.

To make matters worse, the foot-soaking bowl was not rinsed between guests. That alone is enough to make this place unacceptable.

The owners should understand that advertising means nothing if you cannot deliver what you promise. Otherwise, it only leads to distrust and, frankly, disgrace.

reviewList.text: I had a great time at this resort. The place is very beautiful, quiet, and clean.The staff are super friendly. They always smile and help us with everything. reviewList.text:
Song Tra Resort & Spa is a wonderful place to stay if you’re looking for peace and relaxation. I stayed in a spacious two-bedroom villa just 15 metres from the beach, and the setting was simply stunning. The resort is beautifully nestled between the lush jungle of the Sơn Trà Peninsula and a gorgeous private sandy beach, creating a tranquil atmosphere that’s perfect for escaping the hustle and bustle of Da Nang.

The staff were consistently friendly, welcoming, and attentive, making me feel well looked after throughout my stay. If you’re after a quiet beachfront retreat surrounded by nature, I couldn’t recommend this resort more highly. I definitely hope to stay here again on a future visit to Vietnam.
reviewList.author: Duncan Sandeman

reviewList.text:
I had a great stay at Son Tra Resort & Spa. The resort is peaceful, surrounded by beautiful nature, and has a lovely private beach. The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable.

The staff were friendly, helpful, and always ready to assist. The breakfast was delicious with a good variety of options. Overall, it was a relaxing and enjoyable experience. I would definitely recommend this resort and look forward to visiting again.

reviewList.text: SCAMMERS!! I Got scammed here today. The reviews are fake, stay away especially if you’re a westerner. They brought me a masseuse who instantly complained that I’m “too big” and she will not offer anything apart from “hand relief”. I asked for a change of waiters and they brought me another one with a worse attitude than the former. She also said no way she would do anything other than “hand relief”, using the excuse that I’m too big and a “westerner”. This was clearly an excuse and not reality, I would’ve appreciated the compliment if it was real. I settled for whatever she said she would offer and 5 minutes into the session she started barking at me in Vietnamese in a very loud voice for absolutely no reason. I was genuinely shocked and speechless, I had no idea what went wrong as I didn’t even move or open my mouth; the girl was clearly frustrated and had bruises on her chest; her eyes also looked swollen. I became very uncomfortable, ended the session instantly, and walked out. I got a bad sense of trafficking happening at this place, didn’t even bother to ask for my money back because I realized after the first masseuse interaction that I had just gotten scammed. The place is sketchy and I felt unsafe; you have been warned.
